3605.label: Numbers 1:1
3605.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses in the wilderness of Siʹnai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month in the second year of their coming out of the land of Egypt, and he said:

3606.label: Numbers 1:2
3606.text: “TAKE the sum of the whole assembly of the sons of Israel according to their families, according to the house of their fathers, by the number of names, all the males, head by head of them,

3607.label: Numbers 1:3
3607.text: from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army in Israel. YOU should register them according to their armies, you and Aaron.

3608.label: Numbers 1:4
3608.text: “And some men should be with YOU, one man to a tribe; each is a head to the house of his fathers.

3609.label: Numbers 1:5
3609.text: And these are the names of the men who will stand with YOU: Of Reuʹben, E·liʹzur the son of Shedʹe·ur;

3610.label: Numbers 1:6
3610.text: of Simʹe·on, She·luʹmi·el the son of Zu·ri·shadʹdai;

3611.label: Numbers 1:7
3611.text: of Judah, Nahʹshon the son of Am·minʹa·dab;

3612.label: Numbers 1:8
3612.text: of Isʹsa·char, Ne·thanʹel the son of Zuʹar;

3613.label: Numbers 1:9
3613.text: of Zebʹu·lun, E·liʹab the son of Heʹlon;

3614.label: Numbers 1:10
3614.text: of the sons of Joseph: of Eʹphra·im, E·lishʹa·ma the son of Am·miʹhud; of Ma·nasʹseh, Ga·maʹli·el the son of Pe·dahʹzur;

3615.label: Numbers 1:11
3615.text: of Benjamin, Abʹi·dan the son of Gid·e·oʹni;

3616.label: Numbers 1:12
3616.text: of Dan, A·hi·eʹzer the son of Am·mi·shadʹdai;

3617.label: Numbers 1:13
3617.text: of Ashʹer, Paʹgi·el the son of Ochʹran;

3618.label: Numbers 1:14
3618.text: of Gad, E·liʹa·saph the son of Deuʹel;

3619.label: Numbers 1:15
3619.text: of Naphʹta·li, A·hiʹra the son of Eʹnan.

3620.label: Numbers 1:16
3620.text: These are the ones called of the assembly, the chieftains of the tribes of their fathers. They are the heads of the thousands of Israel.”

3621.label: Numbers 1:17
3621.text: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by names.

3622.label: Numbers 1:18
3622.text: And they congregated all the assembly on the first day of the second month, that they might have their descent acknowledged as regards their families in the house of their fathers, by the number of the names, from twenty years old upward, head by head of them,

3623.label: Numbers 1:19
3623.text: just as Jehovah had commanded Moses; and he proceeded to register them in the wilderness of Siʹnai.

3624.label: Numbers 1:20
3624.text: And the sons of Reuʹben, Israel’s firstborn, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers, came to be by the number of names, head by head of them, all the males from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3625.label: Numbers 1:21
3625.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Reuʹben, forty-six thousand five hundred.

3626.label: Numbers 1:22
3626.text: Of the sons of Simʹe·on, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers, those registered ones of his by the number of names, head by head of them, all the males from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3627.label: Numbers 1:23
3627.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Simʹe·on were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

3628.label: Numbers 1:24
3628.text: Of the sons of Gad, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3629.label: Numbers 1:25
3629.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

3630.label: Numbers 1:26
3630.text: Of the sons of Judah, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3631.label: Numbers 1:27
3631.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

3632.label: Numbers 1:28
3632.text: Of the sons of Isʹsa·char, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3633.label: Numbers 1:29
3633.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Isʹsa·char were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

3634.label: Numbers 1:30
3634.text: Of the sons of Zebʹu·lun, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3635.label: Numbers 1:31
3635.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Zebʹu·lun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

3636.label: Numbers 1:32
3636.text: Of the sons of Joseph: of the sons of Eʹphra·im, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3637.label: Numbers 1:33
3637.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Eʹphra·im were forty thousand five hundred.

3638.label: Numbers 1:34
3638.text: Of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3639.label: Numbers 1:35
3639.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

3640.label: Numbers 1:36
3640.text: Of the sons of Benjamin, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3641.label: Numbers 1:37
3641.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Benjamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

3642.label: Numbers 1:38
3642.text: Of the sons of Dan, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3643.label: Numbers 1:39
3643.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

3644.label: Numbers 1:40
3644.text: Of the sons of Ashʹer, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3645.label: Numbers 1:41
3645.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Ashʹer were forty-one thousand five hundred.

3646.label: Numbers 1:42
3646.text: Of the sons of Naphʹta·li, their births according to their families in the house of their fathers by the number of names from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army,

3647.label: Numbers 1:43
3647.text: those registered of them of the tribe of Naphʹta·li were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

3648.label: Numbers 1:44
3648.text: These are the ones registered, whom Moses registered, together with Aaron and the chieftains of Israel, twelve men. They represented one each the house of his fathers.

3649.label: Numbers 1:45
3649.text: And all those registered of the sons of Israel according to the house of their fathers from twenty years old upward, everyone going out to the army in Israel, came to be,

3650.label: Numbers 1:46
3650.text: yes, all those registered came to be six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

3651.label: Numbers 1:47
3651.text: However, the Levites according to the tribe of their fathers did not get registered in among them.

3652.label: Numbers 1:48
3652.text: Accordingly Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

3653.label: Numbers 1:49
3653.text: “Only the tribe of Leʹvi you must not register, and the sum of them you must not take in among the sons of Israel.

3654.label: Numbers 1:50
3654.text: And you yourself appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony and over all its utensils and over everything that belongs to it. They themselves will carry the tabernacle and all its utensils, and they themselves will minister at it; and around the tabernacle they are to camp.

3655.label: Numbers 1:51
3655.text: And whenever the tabernacle is setting out, the Levites should take it down; and when the tabernacle encamps, the Levites should set it up; and any stranger coming near should be put to death.

3656.label: Numbers 1:52
3656.text: “And the sons of Israel must encamp each with reference to his camp, and each man by his [three-tribe] division by their armies.

3657.label: Numbers 1:53
3657.text: And the Levites should encamp around the tabernacle of the Testimony, that no indignation may arise against the assembly of the sons of Israel; and the Levites must keep the service due to the tabernacle of the Testimony.”

3658.label: Numbers 1:54
3658.text: And the sons of Israel proceeded to do according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses. They did just so.

3659.label: Numbers 2:1
3659.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3660.label: Numbers 2:2
3660.text: “The sons of Israel should encamp, each man by his [three-tribe] division, by the signs for the house of their fathers. Round about in front of the tent of meeting they should encamp.

3661.label: Numbers 2:3
3661.text: “And those camping eastward toward the sunrising will be the [three-tribe] division of the camp of Judah in their armies, and the chieftain for the sons of Judah is Nahʹshon the son of Am·minʹa·dab.

3662.label: Numbers 2:4
3662.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are seventy-four thousand six hundred.

3663.label: Numbers 2:5
3663.text: And those camping alongside him will be the tribe of Isʹsa·char, and the chieftain for the sons of Isʹsa·char is Ne·thanʹel the son of Zuʹar.

3664.label: Numbers 2:6
3664.text: And his army and his registered ones are fifty-four thousand four hundred.

3665.label: Numbers 2:7
3665.text: And the tribe of Zebʹu·lun; and the chieftain for the sons of Zebʹu·lun is E·liʹab the son of Heʹlon.

3666.label: Numbers 2:8
3666.text: And his army and his registered ones are fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

3667.label: Numbers 2:9
3667.text: “All the registered ones of the camp of Judah are one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred in their armies. They should set out first.

3668.label: Numbers 2:10
3668.text: “The [three-tribe] division of the camp of Reuʹben will be toward the south in their armies, and the chieftain for the sons of Reuʹben is E·liʹzur the son of Shedʹe·ur.

3669.label: Numbers 2:11
3669.text: And his army and his registered ones are forty-six thousand five hundred.

3670.label: Numbers 2:12
3670.text: And those camping alongside him will be the tribe of Simʹe·on, and the chieftain for the sons of Simʹe·on is She·luʹmi·el the son of Zu·ri·shadʹdai.

3671.label: Numbers 2:13
3671.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

3672.label: Numbers 2:14
3672.text: And the tribe of Gad; and the chieftain for the sons of Gad is E·liʹa·saph the son of Reuʹel.

3673.label: Numbers 2:15
3673.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

3674.label: Numbers 2:16
3674.text: “All the registered ones of the camp of Reuʹben are one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty in their armies, and they should set out second.

3675.label: Numbers 2:17
3675.text: “When the tent of meeting must set out, the camp of the Levites will be in the middle of the camps. “Just as they should encamp, so they should set out, each one at his place, according to their [three-tribe] divisions.

3676.label: Numbers 2:18
3676.text: “The [three-tribe] division of the camp of Eʹphra·im in their armies will be toward the west, and the chieftain for the sons of Eʹphra·im is E·lishʹa·ma the son of Am·miʹhud.

3677.label: Numbers 2:19
3677.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are forty thousand five hundred.

3678.label: Numbers 2:20
3678.text: And alongside him will be the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, and the chieftain for the sons of Ma·nasʹseh is Ga·maʹli·el the son of Pe·dahʹzur.

3679.label: Numbers 2:21
3679.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are thirty-two thousand two hundred.

3680.label: Numbers 2:22
3680.text: And the tribe of Benjamin; and the chieftain for the sons of Benjamin is Abʹi·dan the son of Gid·e·oʹni.

3681.label: Numbers 2:23
3681.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are thirty-five thousand four hundred.

3682.label: Numbers 2:24
3682.text: “All the registered ones of the camp of Eʹphra·im are one hundred and eight thousand one hundred in their armies, and they should set out third.

3683.label: Numbers 2:25
3683.text: “The [three-tribe] division of the camp of Dan will be toward the north in their armies, and the chieftain for the sons of Dan is A·hi·eʹzer the son of Am·mi·shadʹdai.

3684.label: Numbers 2:26
3684.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

3685.label: Numbers 2:27
3685.text: And the ones camping alongside him will be the tribe of Ashʹer, and the chieftain for the sons of Ashʹer is Paʹgi·el the son of Ochʹran.

3686.label: Numbers 2:28
3686.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are forty-one thousand five hundred.

3687.label: Numbers 2:29
3687.text: And the tribe of Naphʹta·li; and the chieftain for the sons of Naphʹta·li is A·hiʹra the son of Eʹnan.

3688.label: Numbers 2:30
3688.text: And his army and the ones registered of them are fifty-three thousand four hundred.

3689.label: Numbers 2:31
3689.text: “All the registered ones of the camp of Dan are one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They should set out last —according to their [three-tribe] divisions.”

3690.label: Numbers 2:32
3690.text: These were the registered ones of the sons of Israel according to the house of their fathers; all the registered ones of the camps in their armies were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

3691.label: Numbers 2:33
3691.text: But the Levites did not get registered in among the sons of Israel, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3692.label: Numbers 2:34
3692.text: And the sons of Israel proceeded to do according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses. That is the way they encamped in their [three-tribe] divisions, and that is the way they set out, each one in his families with regard to the house of his fathers.

3693.label: Numbers 3:1
3693.text: Now these were the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spoke with Moses in Mount Siʹnai.

3694.label: Numbers 3:2
3694.text: And these were the names of Aaron’s sons: the firstborn Naʹdab and A·biʹhu, El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar.

3695.label: Numbers 3:3
3695.text: These were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests whose hands had been filled with power to act as priests.

3696.label: Numbers 3:4
3696.text: However, Naʹdab and A·biʹhu died before Jehovah when they offered illegitimate fire before Jehovah in the wilderness of Siʹnai; and they did not come to have any sons. But El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar continued to act as priests along with Aaron their father.

3697.label: Numbers 3:5
3697.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

3698.label: Numbers 3:6
3698.text: “Bring the tribe of Leʹvi near, and you must stand them before Aaron the priest, and they must minister to him.

3699.label: Numbers 3:7
3699.text: And they must keep their obligation to him and their obligation to all the assembly before the tent of meeting in discharging the service of the tabernacle.

3700.label: Numbers 3:8
3700.text: And they must take care of all the utensils of the tent of meeting, even the obligation of the sons of Israel in discharging the service of the tabernacle.

3701.label: Numbers 3:9
3701.text: And you must give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They are given ones, given to him from the sons of Israel.

3702.label: Numbers 3:10
3702.text: And you should appoint Aaron and his sons, and they must take care of their priesthood; and any stranger coming near should be put to death.”

3703.label: Numbers 3:11
3703.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3704.label: Numbers 3:12
3704.text: “As for me, look! I do take the Levites from among the sons of Israel in place of all the firstborn opening the womb of the sons of Israel; and the Levites must become mine.

3705.label: Numbers 3:13
3705.text: For every firstborn is mine. In the day that I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified to myself every firstborn in Israel from man to beast. They should become mine. I am Jehovah.”

3706.label: Numbers 3:14
3706.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses in the wilderness of Siʹnai, saying:

3707.label: Numbers 3:15
3707.text: “Register the sons of Leʹvi according to the house of their fathers by their families. Every male from a month old upward you should register.”

3708.label: Numbers 3:16
3708.text: And Moses began to register them at the order of Jehovah, just as he had been commanded.

3709.label: Numbers 3:17
3709.text: And these came to be the sons of Leʹvi by their names: Gerʹshon and Koʹhath and Me·rarʹi.

3710.label: Numbers 3:18
3710.text: Now these were the names of the sons of Gerʹshon by their families: Libʹni and Shimʹe·i.

3711.label: Numbers 3:19
3711.text: And the sons of Koʹhath by their families were Amʹram and Izʹhar, Heʹbron and Uzʹzi·el.

3712.label: Numbers 3:20
3712.text: And the sons of Me·rarʹi by their families were Mahʹli and Muʹshi. These were the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

3713.label: Numbers 3:21
3713.text: Of Gerʹshon there were the family of the Libʹnites and the family of the Shimʹe·ites. These were the families of the Gerʹshon·ites.

3714.label: Numbers 3:22
3714.text: Their registered ones were by number of all males from a month old upward. Their registered ones were seven thousand five hundred.

3715.label: Numbers 3:23
3715.text: The families of the Gerʹshon·ites were behind the tabernacle. They were encamped to the west.

3716.label: Numbers 3:24
3716.text: And the chieftain of the paternal house for the Gerʹshon·ites was E·liʹa·saph the son of Laʹel.

3717.label: Numbers 3:25
3717.text: And the obligation of the sons of Gerʹshon in the tent of meeting was the tabernacle and the tent, its covering and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,

3718.label: Numbers 3:26
3718.text: and the hangings of the courtyard and the screen of the entrance of the courtyard that is round about the tabernacle and the altar, and its tent cords, for all its service.

3719.label: Numbers 3:27
3719.text: And of Koʹhath there were the family of the Amʹram·ites and the family of the Izʹhar·ites and the family of the Heʹbron·ites and the family of the Uz·ziʹel·ites. These were the families of the Koʹhath·ites.

3720.label: Numbers 3:28
3720.text: Among the number of all the males from a month old upward there were eight thousand six hundred, taking care of the obligation to the holy place.

3721.label: Numbers 3:29
3721.text: The families of the sons of Koʹhath were encamped on the side of the tabernacle to the south.

3722.label: Numbers 3:30
3722.text: And the chieftain of the paternal house for the families of the Koʹhath·ites was E·li·zaʹphan the son of Uzʹzi·el.

3723.label: Numbers 3:31
3723.text: And their obligation was the Ark and the table and the lampstand and the altars and the utensils of the holy place with which they would minister and the screen, and all its service.

3724.label: Numbers 3:32
3724.text: And the chieftain of the chieftains of the Levites was El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest, who had the oversight of those taking care of the obligation to the holy place.

3725.label: Numbers 3:33
3725.text: Of Me·rarʹi there were the family of the Mahʹlites and the family of the Muʹshites. These were the families of Me·rarʹi.

3726.label: Numbers 3:34
3726.text: And their registered ones by the number of all the males from a month old upward were six thousand two hundred.

3727.label: Numbers 3:35
3727.text: And the chieftain of the paternal house for the families of Me·rarʹi was Zuʹri·el the son of Abʹi·ha·il. They were encamped on the side of the tabernacle toward the north.

3728.label: Numbers 3:36
3728.text: And the oversight for which the sons of Me·rarʹi were obligated was over the panel frames of the tabernacle and its bars and its pillars and its socket pedestals and all its utensils and all its service,

3729.label: Numbers 3:37
3729.text: and the pillars of the courtyard round about and their socket pedestals and their tent pins and their tent cords.

3730.label: Numbers 3:38
3730.text: And those camping before the tabernacle toward the east, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, those taking care of the obligation to the sanctuary, as the obligation for the sons of Israel. And any stranger coming near would be put to death.

3731.label: Numbers 3:39
3731.text: All the registered ones of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron registered at the order of Jehovah by their families, all the males from a month old upward, were twenty-two thousand.

3732.label: Numbers 3:40
3732.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Register all the firstborn males of the sons of Israel from a month old upward, and take the number of their names.

3733.label: Numbers 3:41
3733.text: And you must take the Levites for me—I am Jehovah—in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the domestic animals of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the domestic animals of the sons of Israel.”

3734.label: Numbers 3:42
3734.text: And Moses proceeded, just as Jehovah had commanded him, to register all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.

3735.label: Numbers 3:43
3735.text: And all the firstborn males by the number of the names from a month old upward of their registered ones came to be twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.

3736.label: Numbers 3:44
3736.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3737.label: Numbers 3:45
3737.text: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the domestic animals of the Levites in place of their domestic animals; and the Levites must become mine. I am Jehovah.

3738.label: Numbers 3:46
3738.text: And as the ransom price of the two hundred and seventy-three from the firstborn of the sons of Israel, who are in excess of the Levites,

3739.label: Numbers 3:47
3739.text: you must take five shekels for each individual. In the shekel of the holy place you should take it. A shekel is twenty geʹrahs.

3740.label: Numbers 3:48
3740.text: And you must give the money to Aaron and his sons as the ransom price of those who are in excess of them.”

3741.label: Numbers 3:49
3741.text: So Moses took the money of the redemption price from those who were in excess of the ransom price of the Levites.

3742.label: Numbers 3:50
3742.text: From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the money, a thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, in the shekel of the holy place.

3743.label: Numbers 3:51
3743.text: Then Moses gave the money of the ransom price to Aaron and his sons according to the order of Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3744.label: Numbers 4:1
3744.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3745.label: Numbers 4:2
3745.text: “There will be a taking of the sum of the sons of Koʹhath from among the sons of Leʹvi, according to their families in the house of their fathers,

3746.label: Numbers 4:3
3746.text: from thirty years old upward to fifty years old, all those going into the service group to do the work in the tent of meeting.

3747.label: Numbers 4:4
3747.text: “This is the service of the sons of Koʹhath in the tent of meeting. It is something most holy:

3748.label: Numbers 4:5
3748.text: And Aaron and his sons must come in when the camp is departing, and they must take down the screening curtain and must cover the ark of the testimony with it.

3749.label: Numbers 4:6
3749.text: And they must put a covering of sealskins over it and spread out an entire cloth of blue on top and put in its poles.

3750.label: Numbers 4:7
3750.text: “And they will spread out a cloth of blue over the table of showbread, and they must put upon it the dishes and the cups and the bowls and the pitchers of the drink offering; and the constant bread should continue on it.

3751.label: Numbers 4:8
3751.text: And they must spread out a cloth of coccus scarlet over them, and they must cover it with a covering of sealskins and put in its poles.

3752.label: Numbers 4:9
3752.text: And they must take a cloth of blue and cover the lampstand of the luminary and its lamps and its snuffers and its fire holders and all its vessels for oil with which they regularly minister to it.

3753.label: Numbers 4:10
3753.text: And they must put it and all its utensils into a covering of sealskins and put it upon a bar.

3754.label: Numbers 4:11
3754.text: And over the golden altar they will spread out a cloth of blue, and they must cover it with a covering of sealskins and put in its poles.

3755.label: Numbers 4:12
3755.text: And they must take all the utensils of the ministry with which they regularly minister in the holy place, and they must put them in a cloth of blue and cover them with a covering of sealskins and put them upon a bar.

3756.label: Numbers 4:13
3756.text: “And they must clear away the fatty ashes of the altar and spread out a cloth of wool dyed reddish purple over it.

3757.label: Numbers 4:14
3757.text: And they must put upon it all its utensils with which they regularly minister at it, the fire holders, the forks and the shovels and the bowls, all the utensils of the altar; and they must spread out over it a covering of sealskins and put in its poles.

3758.label: Numbers 4:15
3758.text: “And Aaron and his sons must finish covering the holy place and all the utensils of the holy place when the camp is departing, and after that the sons of Koʹhath will come in to carry them, but they must not touch the holy place so that they have to die. These things are the load of the sons of Koʹhath in the tent of meeting.

3759.label: Numbers 4:16
3759.text: “And the oversight of El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest is over the oil of the luminary and the perfumed incense and the constant grain offering and the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle and all that is in it, namely, the holy place and its utensils.”

3760.label: Numbers 4:17
3760.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3761.label: Numbers 4:18
3761.text: “Do not let the tribe of the families of the Koʹhath·ites be cut off from among the Levites.

3762.label: Numbers 4:19
3762.text: But do this for them that they may indeed keep alive and may not die for their approaching the most holy things. Aaron and his sons will come in, and they must assign them each one to his service and to his load.

3763.label: Numbers 4:20
3763.text: And they must not come in to see the holy things for the least moment of time, and so they have to die.”

3764.label: Numbers 4:21
3764.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

3765.label: Numbers 4:22
3765.text: “There will be a taking of the sum of the sons of Gerʹshon, yes, them by the house of their fathers according to their families.

3766.label: Numbers 4:23
3766.text: From thirty years old upward to fifty years you will register them, all who come to enter into the service group to render service in the tent of meeting.

3767.label: Numbers 4:24
3767.text: This is the service of the families of the Gerʹshon·ites as to serving and as to carrying.

3768.label: Numbers 4:25
3768.text: And they must carry the tent cloths of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting, its covering and the sealskin covering that is on top over it, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,

3769.label: Numbers 4:26
3769.text: and the hangings of the courtyard and the entrance screen of the gate of the courtyard that is round about the tabernacle and the altar, and their tent cords and all their service utensils, and all things with which work is regularly done. Thus they must serve.

3770.label: Numbers 4:27
3770.text: At the order of Aaron and his sons all the service of the sons of the Gerʹshon·ites should take place as regards all their loads and all their service, and YOU must assign all their loads to them by obligation.

3771.label: Numbers 4:28
3771.text: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gerʹshon·ites in the tent of meeting, and their obligatory service is under the hand of Ithʹa·mar the son of Aaron the priest.

3772.label: Numbers 4:29
3772.text: “As for the sons of Me·rarʹi, you will register them by their families in the house of their fathers.

3773.label: Numbers 4:30
3773.text: From thirty years old upward to fifty years you will register them, all who enter into the service group to render the service of the tent of meeting.

3774.label: Numbers 4:31
3774.text: And this is their obligation, their load, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the panel frames of the tabernacle and its bars and its pillars and its socket pedestals,

3775.label: Numbers 4:32
3775.text: and the pillars of the courtyard round about and their socket pedestals and their tent pins and their tent cords together with all their equipment and all their service. And by their names YOU will assign the equipment for which they are obligated, as their load.

3776.label: Numbers 4:33
3776.text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Me·rarʹi according to all their service in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithʹa·mar the son of Aaron the priest.”

3777.label: Numbers 4:34
3777.text: And Moses and Aaron and the chieftains of the assembly proceeded to register the sons of the Koʹhath·ites by their families and by the house of their fathers,

3778.label: Numbers 4:35
3778.text: from thirty years old upward to fifty years, all who entered into the service group for the service in the tent of meeting.

3779.label: Numbers 4:36
3779.text: And the ones registered of them by their families came to be two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

3780.label: Numbers 4:37
3780.text: These are the registered ones of the families of the Koʹhath·ites, all those serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the order of Jehovah by means of Moses.

3781.label: Numbers 4:38
3781.text: As for the registered ones of the sons of Gerʹshon by their families and by the house of their fathers,

3782.label: Numbers 4:39
3782.text: from thirty years old upward to fifty years, all who entered into the service group for the service in the tent of meeting,

3783.label: Numbers 4:40
3783.text: the ones registered of them by their families, by the house of their fathers, came to be two thousand six hundred and thirty.

3784.label: Numbers 4:41
3784.text: These were the registered ones of the families of the sons of Gerʹshon, all those serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the order of Jehovah.

3785.label: Numbers 4:42
3785.text: As for the registered ones of the families of the sons of Me·rarʹi by their families, by the house of their fathers,

3786.label: Numbers 4:43
3786.text: from thirty years old upward to fifty years old, all those entering into the service group for the service in the tent of meeting,

3787.label: Numbers 4:44
3787.text: the ones registered of them by their families came to be three thousand two hundred.

3788.label: Numbers 4:45
3788.text: These were the registered ones of the families of the sons of Me·rarʹi, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the order of Jehovah by means of Moses.

3789.label: Numbers 4:46
3789.text: All the registered ones whom Moses and Aaron and the chieftains of Israel registered as Levites by their families and by the house of their fathers,

3790.label: Numbers 4:47
3790.text: from thirty years old upward to fifty years old, all those coming to render the laborious service and the service of carrying loads in the tent of meeting,

3791.label: Numbers 4:48
3791.text: their registered ones came to be eight thousand five hundred and eighty.

3792.label: Numbers 4:49
3792.text: At the order of Jehovah they were registered by means of Moses, each one according to his service and his load; and they were registered just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3793.label: Numbers 5:1
3793.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3794.label: Numbers 5:2
3794.text: “Command the sons of Israel that they send out of the camp every leprous person and everyone having a running discharge and everyone unclean by a deceased soul.

3795.label: Numbers 5:3
3795.text: Whether a male or a female YOU should send them out. YOU should send them outside the camp, that they may not contaminate the camps of those in the midst of whom I am tabernacling.”

3796.label: Numbers 5:4
3796.text: And the sons of Israel proceeded to do so, even to send them outside the camp. Just as Jehovah had spoken to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.

3797.label: Numbers 5:5
3797.text: And Jehovah continued speaking to Moses, saying:

3798.label: Numbers 5:6
3798.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, ‘As for a man or a woman, in case they do any of all the sins of mankind in committing an act of unfaithfulness against Jehovah, that soul has also become guilty.

3799.label: Numbers 5:7
3799.text: And they must confess their sin that they have done, and he must return the amount of his guilt in its principal, also adding a fifth of it to it, and he must give it to the one against whom he did wrong.

3800.label: Numbers 5:8
3800.text: But if the latter has no near relative to whom to return the amount of the guilt, the amount of the guilt that is being returned to Jehovah belongs to the priest, except the ram of atonement with which he will make atonement for him.

3801.label: Numbers 5:9
3801.text: “‘And every contribution of all the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they will present to the priest, should become his.

3802.label: Numbers 5:10
3802.text: And the holy things of each one will remain his own. Whatever each one may give to the priest, that will become his.’”

3803.label: Numbers 5:11
3803.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

3804.label: Numbers 5:12
3804.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘In case any man’s wife turns aside in that she does commit an act of unfaithfulness against him,

3805.label: Numbers 5:13
3805.text: and another man actually lies down with her and has an emission of semen, and it has been hidden from the eyes of her husband and has remained undiscovered, and she, on her part, has defiled herself but there is no witness against her, and she herself has not been caught;

3806.label: Numbers 5:14
3806.text: and the spirit of jealousy has passed upon him, and he has become suspicious of his wife’s faithfulness, and she in fact has defiled herself, or the spirit of jealousy has passed upon him, and he has become suspicious of his wife’s faithfulness, but she in fact has not defiled herself;

3807.label: Numbers 5:15
3807.text: then the man must bring his wife to the priest and bring her offering along with her, a tenth of an eʹphah of barley flour. He must not pour oil upon it nor put frankincense upon it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, a memorial grain offering bringing error to remembrance.

3808.label: Numbers 5:16
3808.text: “‘And the priest must bring her forward and make her stand before Jehovah.

3809.label: Numbers 5:17
3809.text: And the priest must take holy water in an earthenware vessel, and the priest will take some of the dust that happens to be on the floor of the tabernacle, and he must put it in the water.

3810.label: Numbers 5:18
3810.text: And the priest must make the woman stand before Jehovah and loosen the hair of the woman’s head and put upon her palms the memorial grain offering, that is, the grain offering of jealousy, and in the hand of the priest there should be the bitter water that brings a curse.

3811.label: Numbers 5:19
3811.text: “‘And the priest must make her swear, and he must say to the woman: “If no man has lain down with you and if while under your husband you have not turned aside in any uncleanness, be free of the effect of this bitter water that brings a curse.

3812.label: Numbers 5:20
3812.text: But you, in case you have turned aside while under your husband and in case you have defiled yourself and some man has put in you his seminal emission, besides your husband,—”

3813.label: Numbers 5:21
3813.text: The priest must now make the woman swear with an oath involving cursing, and the priest must say to the woman: “May Jehovah set you for a cursing and an oath in the midst of your people by Jehovah’s letting your thigh fall away, and your belly swell.

3814.label: Numbers 5:22
3814.text: And this water that brings a curse must enter into your intestines to cause your belly to swell and the thigh to fall away.” To this the woman must say: “Amen! Amen!”

3815.label: Numbers 5:23
3815.text: “‘And the priest must write these cursings in the book and must wipe them out into the bitter water.

3816.label: Numbers 5:24
3816.text: And he must make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the water that brings a curse must enter into her as something bitter.

3817.label: Numbers 5:25
3817.text: And the priest must take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand and wave the grain offering to and fro before Jehovah, and he must bring it near the altar.

3818.label: Numbers 5:26
3818.text: And the priest must grasp some of the grain offering as a remembrancer of it and must make it smoke upon the altar, and afterward he will make the woman drink the water.

3819.label: Numbers 5:27
3819.text: When he has made her drink the water, it must also occur that if she has defiled herself in that she committed an act of unfaithfulness toward her husband, the water that brings a curse must then enter into her as something bitter, and her belly must swell, and her thigh must fall away, and the woman must become a cursing in among her people.

3820.label: Numbers 5:28
3820.text: However, if the woman has not defiled herself but she is clean, she must then be free from such punishment; and she must be made pregnant with semen.

3821.label: Numbers 5:29
3821.text: “‘This is the law about jealousy, where a woman may turn aside while under her husband, and she does defile herself,

3822.label: Numbers 5:30
3822.text: or in the case of a man where the spirit of jealousy may pass upon him, and he does suspect his wife of unfaithfulness; and he must make the wife stand before Jehovah, and the priest must carry out toward her all this law.

3823.label: Numbers 5:31
3823.text: And the man must be innocent of error, but that wife will answer for her error.’”

3824.label: Numbers 6:1
3824.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3825.label: Numbers 6:2
3825.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel and you must say to them, ‘In case a man or a woman takes a special vow to live as a Nazʹi·rite to Jehovah,

3826.label: Numbers 6:3
3826.text: he should keep away from wine and intoxicating liquor. He should not drink the vinegar of wine or the vinegar of intoxicating liquor, nor drink any liquid made from grapes, nor eat grapes either fresh or dried.

3827.label: Numbers 6:4
3827.text: All the days of his Naziriteship he should not eat anything at all that is made from the wine vine, from the unripe grapes to the skins.

3828.label: Numbers 6:5
3828.text: “‘All the days of the vow of his Naziriteship no razor should pass over his head; until the days that he should be separated to Jehovah come to the full, he should prove holy by letting the locks of the hair of his head grow.

3829.label: Numbers 6:6
3829.text: All the days of his keeping separate to Jehovah he may not come toward any dead soul.

3830.label: Numbers 6:7
3830.text: Not even for his father or his mother or his brother or his sister may he defile himself when they die, because the sign of his Naziriteship to his God is upon his head.

3831.label: Numbers 6:8
3831.text: “‘All the days of his Naziriteship he is holy to Jehovah.

3832.label: Numbers 6:9
3832.text: But in case anyone dying should die quite suddenly alongside him so that he has defiled the head of his Naziriteship, he must then shave his head in the day of establishing his purification. On the seventh day he should shave it.

3833.label: Numbers 6:10
3833.text: And on the eighth day he should bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3834.label: Numbers 6:11
3834.text: And the priest must handle one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering and make atonement for him, since he has sinned because of the [dead] soul. Then he must sanctify his head on that day.

3835.label: Numbers 6:12
3835.text: And he must live as a Nazʹi·rite to Jehovah for the days of his Naziriteship, and he must bring a young ram in its first year as a guilt offering; and the former days will go uncounted because he defiled his Naziriteship.

3836.label: Numbers 6:13
3836.text: “‘Now this is the law about the Nazʹi·rite: On the day that the days of his Naziriteship come to the full, he will be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3837.label: Numbers 6:14
3837.text: And he must present as his offering to Jehovah one sound young ram in its first year as a burnt offering and one sound female lamb in its first year as a sin offering and one sound ram as a communion sacrifice,

3838.label: Numbers 6:15
3838.text: and a basket of unfermented ring-shaped cakes of fine flour, moistened with oil, and unfermented wafers smeared with oil, and their grain offering and their drink offerings.

3839.label: Numbers 6:16
3839.text: And the priest must present them before Jehovah and render up his sin offering and his burnt offering.

3840.label: Numbers 6:17
3840.text: And he will render up the ram as a communion sacrifice to Jehovah along with the basket of unfermented cakes; and the priest must render up its grain offering and its drink offering.

3841.label: Numbers 6:18
3841.text: “‘And the Nazʹi·rite must shave the head of his Naziriteship at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and he must take the hair of the head of his Naziriteship and put it upon the fire that is under the communion sacrifice.

3842.label: Numbers 6:19
3842.text: And the priest must take a boiled shoulder from the ram and one unfermented ring-shaped cake out of the basket, and one unfermented wafer, and put them upon the palms of the Nazʹi·rite after he has had the sign of his Naziriteship shaved off.

3843.label: Numbers 6:20
3843.text: And the priest must wave them to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah. It is something holy for the priest, along with the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the contribution. And afterward the Nazʹi·rite may drink wine.

3844.label: Numbers 6:21
3844.text: “‘This is the law about the Nazʹi·rite who vows—his offering to Jehovah over his Naziriteship, besides that which he can afford. According to his vow that he may make, so he should do because of the law of his Naziriteship.’”

3845.label: Numbers 6:22
3845.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

3846.label: Numbers 6:23
3846.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the way YOU should bless the sons of Israel, saying to them:

3847.label: Numbers 6:24
3847.text: “May Jehovah bless you and keep you.

3848.label: Numbers 6:25
3848.text: May Jehovah make his face shine toward you, and may he favor you.

3849.label: Numbers 6:26
3849.text: May Jehovah lift up his face toward you and assign peace to you.”’

3850.label: Numbers 6:27
3850.text: And they must place my name upon the sons of Israel, that I myself may bless them.”

3851.label: Numbers 7:1
3851.text: Now it came about on the day that Moses finished setting up the tabernacle that he proceeded to anoint it and to sanctify it and all its furnishings and the altar and all its utensils. Thus he anointed them and sanctified them.

3852.label: Numbers 7:2
3852.text: Then the chieftains of Israel, the heads of the house of their fathers, made a presentation, they being the chieftains of the tribes and standing over the ones registered,

3853.label: Numbers 7:3
3853.text: and they brought their offering before Jehovah, six covered wagons and twelve cattle, a wagon for two chieftains and a bull for each one; and they presented them before the tabernacle.

3854.label: Numbers 7:4
3854.text: At this Jehovah said to Moses:

3855.label: Numbers 7:5
3855.text: “Accept them from them, as they must serve for carrying on the service of the tent of meeting, and you must give them to the Levites, each one in proportion to his own service.”

3856.label: Numbers 7:6
3856.text: So Moses accepted the wagons and the cattle and gave them to the Levites.

3857.label: Numbers 7:7
3857.text: Two wagons and four cattle he gave to the sons of Gerʹshon in proportion to their service,

3858.label: Numbers 7:8
3858.text: and four wagons and eight cattle he gave to the sons of Me·rarʹi in proportion to their service, under the hand of Ithʹa·mar the son of Aaron the priest.

3859.label: Numbers 7:9
3859.text: But to the sons of Koʹhath he gave none, because the service of the holy place was upon them. They did their carrying on the shoulder.

3860.label: Numbers 7:10
3860.text: Now the chieftains made their presentation at the inauguration of the altar on the day of its being anointed, and the chieftains proceeded with presenting their offering before the altar.

3861.label: Numbers 7:11
3861.text: So Jehovah said to Moses: “One chieftain on one day and another chieftain on another day is the way they will present their offering for the inauguration of the altar.”

3862.label: Numbers 7:12
3862.text: Now the one presenting his offering on the first day proved to be Nahʹshon the son of Am·minʹa·dab of the tribe of Judah.

3863.label: Numbers 7:13
3863.text: And his offering was one silver dish, its weight being a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour moistened with oil for a grain offering;

3864.label: Numbers 7:14
3864.text: one gold cup of ten shekels, full of incense;

3865.label: Numbers 7:15
3865.text: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering;

3866.label: Numbers 7:16
3866.text: one kid of the goats for a sin offering;

3867.label: Numbers 7:17
3867.text: and for a communion sacrifice two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, five male lambs each a year old. This was the offering of Nahʹshon the son of Am·minʹa·dab.

3868.label: Numbers 7:18
3868.text: On the second day Ne·thanʹel the son of Zuʹar, the chieftain of Isʹsa·char, made a presentation.

3869.label: Numbers 7:19
3869.text: He presented as his offering one silver dish, its weight being a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour moistened with oil for a grain offering;

3873.label: Numbers 7:23
3873.text: and for a communion sacrifice two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, five male lambs each a year old. This was the offering of Ne·thanʹel the son of Zuʹar.

3874.text: On the third day there was the chieftain for the sons of Zebʹu·lun, E·liʹab the son of Heʹlon.

3916.text: On the tenth day there was the chieftain for the sons of Dan, A·hi·eʹzer the son of Am·mi·shadʹdai.

3917.label: Numbers 7:67
3917.text: His offering was one silver dish, its weight being a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour moistened with oil for a grain offering;

3918.label: Numbers 7:68
3918.text: one gold cup of ten shekels, full of incense;

3919.label: Numbers 7:69
3919.text: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering;

3920.label: Numbers 7:70
3920.text: one kid of the goats for a sin offering;

3921.label: Numbers 7:71
3921.text: and for a communion sacrifice two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, five male lambs each a year old. This was the offering of A·hi·eʹzer the son of Am·mi·shadʹdai.

3922.label: Numbers 7:72
3922.text: On the eleventh day there was the chieftain for the sons of Ashʹer, Paʹgi·el the son of Ochʹran.

3923.label: Numbers 7:73
3923.text: His offering was one silver dish, its weight being a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour moistened with oil for a grain offering;

3924.label: Numbers 7:74
3924.text: one gold cup of ten shekels, full of incense;

3925.label: Numbers 7:75
3925.text: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering;

3926.label: Numbers 7:76
3926.text: one kid of the goats for a sin offering;

3927.label: Numbers 7:77
3927.text: and for a communion sacrifice two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, five male lambs each a year old. This was the offering of Paʹgi·el the son of Ochʹran.

3928.label: Numbers 7:78
3928.text: On the twelfth day there was the chieftain for the sons of Naphʹta·li, A·hiʹra the son of Eʹnan.

3929.label: Numbers 7:79
3929.text: His offering was one silver dish, its weight being a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour moistened with oil for a grain offering;

3930.label: Numbers 7:80
3930.text: one gold cup of ten shekels, full of incense;

3931.label: Numbers 7:81
3931.text: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering;

3932.label: Numbers 7:82
3932.text: one kid of the goats for a sin offering;

3933.label: Numbers 7:83
3933.text: and for a communion sacrifice two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, five male lambs each a year old. This was the offering of A·hiʹra the son of Eʹnan.

3934.label: Numbers 7:84
3934.text: This was the inauguration offering of the altar on the day of its being anointed, on the part of the chieftains of Israel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, twelve gold cups;

3935.label: Numbers 7:85
3935.text: a hundred and thirty shekels to each silver dish, and seventy to each bowl, all the silver of the vessels being two thousand four hundred shekels by the shekel of the holy place;

3936.label: Numbers 7:86
3936.text: the twelve gold cups full of incense being ten shekels respectively to a cup by the shekel of the holy place, all the gold of the cups being a hundred and twenty shekels;

3937.label: Numbers 7:87
3937.text: all the cattle for the burnt offering being twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs each a year old and their grain offerings, and twelve kids of the goats for a sin offering;

3938.label: Numbers 7:88
3938.text: and all the cattle of the communion sacrifice being twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty he-goats, sixty male lambs each a year old. This was the inauguration offering of the altar after its being anointed.

3939.label: Numbers 7:89
3939.text: Now whenever Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, then he would hear the voice conversing with him from above the cover that was upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubs; and he would speak to him.

3940.label: Numbers 8:1
3940.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

3941.label: Numbers 8:2
3941.text: “Speak to Aaron, and you must say to him, ‘Whenever you light up the lamps, the seven lamps should shine on the area in front of the lampstand.’”

3942.label: Numbers 8:3
3942.text: And Aaron began to do so. He lit up its lamps for the area in front of the lampstand, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3943.label: Numbers 8:4
3943.text: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand. It was hammered work of gold. Up to its sides and up to its blossoms it was hammered work. According to the vision that Jehovah had shown Moses, so he had made the lampstand.

3944.label: Numbers 8:5
3944.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3945.label: Numbers 8:6
3945.text: “Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and you must cleanse them.

3946.label: Numbers 8:7
3946.text: And this is what you should do to them to cleanse them: Spatter sin-cleansing water upon them, and they must have a razor pass over all their flesh and must wash their garments and cleanse themselves.

3947.label: Numbers 8:8
3947.text: Then they must take a young bull and its grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil, and you will take another young bull for a sin offering.

3948.label: Numbers 8:9
3948.text: And you must present the Levites before the tent of meeting and congregate all the assembly of the sons of Israel.

3949.label: Numbers 8:10
3949.text: And you must present the Levites before Jehovah, and the sons of Israel must lay their hands upon the Levites.

3950.label: Numbers 8:11
3950.text: And Aaron must cause the Levites to move to and fro before Jehovah as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, and they must serve for carrying on the service of Jehovah.

3951.label: Numbers 8:12
3951.text: “Then the Levites will lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls. After that, render up the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to Jehovah to make atonement for the Levites.

3952.label: Numbers 8:13
3952.text: And you must have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and must cause them to move to and fro as a wave offering to Jehovah.

3953.label: Numbers 8:14
3953.text: And you must separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites must become mine.

3954.label: Numbers 8:15
3954.text: And afterward the Levites will come in to serve at the tent of meeting. So you must cleanse them and cause them to move to and fro as a wave offering.

3955.label: Numbers 8:16
3955.text: For they are given ones, given to me from among the sons of Israel. In place of those opening all wombs, all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, I must take them for myself.

3956.label: Numbers 8:17
3956.text: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is mine, among man and among beast. On the day of my striking every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them to myself.

3957.label: Numbers 8:18
3957.text: And I shall take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.

3958.label: Numbers 8:19
3958.text: And I shall give the Levites as given ones to Aaron and his sons from among the sons of Israel, to carry on the service of the sons of Israel in the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the sons of Israel, that no plague may occur among the sons of Israel because the sons of Israel approach the holy place.”

3959.label: Numbers 8:20
3959.text: And Moses and Aaron and all the assembly of the sons of Israel proceeded to do so to the Levites. In accord with all that Jehovah had commanded Moses as regards the Levites, that is the way the sons of Israel did to them.

3960.label: Numbers 8:21
3960.text: So the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments, after which Aaron caused them to move to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah. Then Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

3961.label: Numbers 8:22
3961.text: First after that the Levites came in to carry on their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons. Just as Jehovah had commanded Moses respecting the Levites, so they did to them.

3962.label: Numbers 8:23
3962.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses, saying:

3963.label: Numbers 8:24
3963.text: “This is what applies to the Levites: From twenty-five years old upward he will come to enter into the company in the service of the tent of meeting.

3964.label: Numbers 8:25
3964.text: But after the age of fifty years he will retire from the service company and serve no longer.

3965.label: Numbers 8:26
3965.text: And he must minister to his brothers in the tent of meeting in taking care of the obligation, but he must render no service. In accord with this you will do to the Levites in their obligations.”

3966.label: Numbers 9:1
3966.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses in the wilderness of Siʹnai in the second year of their coming out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying:

3967.label: Numbers 9:2
3967.text: “Now the sons of Israel should prepare the passover sacrifice at its appointed time.

3968.label: Numbers 9:3
3968.text: On the fourteenth day in this month between the two evenings YOU should prepare it at its appointed time. According to all its statutes and all its regular procedures YOU should prepare it.”

3969.label: Numbers 9:4
3969.text: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to prepare the passover sacrifice.

3970.label: Numbers 9:5
3970.text: Then they prepared the passover sacrifice in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month between the two evenings, in the wilderness of Siʹnai. According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did.

3971.label: Numbers 9:6
3971.text: Now there happened to be men who had become unclean by a human soul so that they were not able to prepare the passover sacrifice on that day. Hence they presented themselves before Moses and Aaron on that day.

3972.label: Numbers 9:7
3972.text: Then those men said to him: “We are unclean by a human soul. Why should we be restrained from presenting the offering to Jehovah at its appointed time in the midst of the sons of Israel?”

3973.label: Numbers 9:8
3973.text: At this Moses said to them: “Stand there, and let me hear what Jehovah may command regarding YOU.”

3974.label: Numbers 9:9
3974.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

3975.label: Numbers 9:10
3975.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Although any man of YOU or of YOUR generations should happen to be unclean by a soul or off on a distant journey, he too must prepare the passover sacrifice to Jehovah.

3976.label: Numbers 9:11
3976.text: In the second month, on the fourteenth day between the two evenings, they should prepare it. Together with unfermented cakes and bitter greens they should eat it.

3977.label: Numbers 9:12
3977.text: They must not let any of it remain until morning, and they should break no bone in it. According to the whole statute of the passover they should prepare it.

3978.label: Numbers 9:13
3978.text: But when the man was clean or did not happen to be off on a journey and neglected to prepare the passover sacrifice, that soul must then be cut off from his people, because the offering of Jehovah he did not present at its appointed time. For his sin that man will answer.

3979.label: Numbers 9:14
3979.text: “‘And in case an alien resident should be residing with YOU as an alien, he also must prepare the passover sacrifice to Jehovah. According to the statute of the passover and according to its regular procedure is the way he should do. There should exist one statute for YOU people, both for the alien resident and for the native of the land.’”

3980.label: Numbers 9:15
3980.text: Now on the day of setting up the tabernacle the cloud covered the tabernacle of the tent of the Testimony, but in the evening what appeared to be fire continued over the tabernacle until morning.

3981.label: Numbers 9:16
3981.text: That is the way it went on constantly: The cloud would cover it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

3982.label: Numbers 9:17
3982.text: And whenever the cloud would go up from over the tent, the sons of Israel would pull away right afterward, and in the place where the cloud would reside, there is where the sons of Israel would encamp.

3983.label: Numbers 9:18
3983.text: At the order of Jehovah the sons of Israel would pull away, and at the order of Jehovah they would encamp. All the days that the cloud would reside over the tabernacle, they would remain encamped.

3984.label: Numbers 9:19
3984.text: And when the cloud prolonged its stay over the tabernacle many days, the sons of Israel also kept their obligation to Jehovah that they should not pull away.

3985.label: Numbers 9:20
3985.text: And sometimes the cloud would continue a few days over the tabernacle. At the order of Jehovah they would remain encamped, and at the order of Jehovah they would pull away.

3986.label: Numbers 9:21
3986.text: And sometimes the cloud would continue from evening to morning; and the cloud lifted itself in the morning, and they pulled away. Whether it was by day or by night that the cloud lifted itself, they also pulled away.

3987.label: Numbers 9:22
3987.text: Whether it was two days or a month or more days during which the cloud prolonged its stay over the tabernacle by residing over it, the sons of Israel remained encamped and would not pull away, but when it lifted itself they would pull away.

3988.label: Numbers 9:23
3988.text: At the order of Jehovah they would encamp, and at the order of Jehovah they would pull away. They kept their obligation to Jehovah at the order of Jehovah by means of Moses.

3989.label: Numbers 10:1
3989.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

3990.label: Numbers 10:2
3990.text: “Make for yourself two trumpets of silver. You will make them of hammered work, and they must be at your service for convening the assembly and for breaking up the camps.

3991.label: Numbers 10:3
3991.text: And they must blow on them both, and the whole assembly must keep their appointment with you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3992.label: Numbers 10:4
3992.text: And if they should blow on just one, the chieftains as heads of the thousands of Israel must also keep their appointment with you.

3993.label: Numbers 10:5
3993.text: “And YOU men must blow a fluctuating blast, and the camps of those camping to the east must pull away.

3994.label: Numbers 10:6
3994.text: And YOU must blow a fluctuating blast a second time, and the camps of those camping to the south must pull away. They should blow a fluctuating blast for each time one of them pulls away.

3995.label: Numbers 10:7
3995.text: “Now when calling the congregation together, YOU should blow, but YOU must not sound a fluctuating blast.

3996.label: Numbers 10:8
3996.text: And Aaron’s sons, the priests, should blow on the trumpets, and the use of them must serve as a statute for YOU men to time indefinite during YOUR generations.

3997.label: Numbers 10:9
3997.text: “And in case YOU should enter into war in YOUR land against the oppressor who is harassing YOU, YOU must also sound a war call on the trumpets, and YOU will certainly be remembered before Jehovah YOUR God and be saved from YOUR enemies.

3998.label: Numbers 10:10
3998.text: “And in the day of YOUR rejoicing and in YOUR festal seasons and at the commencements of YOUR months, YOU must blow on the trumpets over YOUR burnt offerings and YOUR communion sacrifices; and their use must serve as a memorial for YOU before YOUR God. I am Jehovah YOUR God.”

3999.label: Numbers 10:11
3999.text: Now it came about that in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day in the month, the cloud lifted itself from over the tabernacle of the Testimony.

4000.label: Numbers 10:12
4000.text: And the sons of Israel began to pull away in the manner of their departures from the wilderness of Siʹnai, and the cloud proceeded to reside in the wilderness of Paʹran.

4001.label: Numbers 10:13
4001.text: And they began pulling away for the first time, according to the order of Jehovah by means of Moses.

4002.label: Numbers 10:14
4002.text: So the [three-tribe] division of the camp of the sons of Judah pulled away first of all in their armies, and Nahʹshon the son of Am·minʹa·dab was over its army.

4003.label: Numbers 10:15
4003.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Isʹsa·char there was Ne·thanʹel the son of Zuʹar.

4004.label: Numbers 10:16
4004.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Zebʹu·lun there was E·liʹab the son of Heʹlon.

4005.label: Numbers 10:17
4005.text: And the tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gerʹshon and the sons of Me·rarʹi as carriers of the tabernacle pulled away.

4006.label: Numbers 10:18
4006.text: And the [three-tribe] division of the camp of Reuʹben pulled away in their armies, and E·liʹzur the son of Shedʹe·ur was over its army.

4007.label: Numbers 10:19
4007.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on there was She·luʹmi·el the son of Zu·ri·shadʹdai.

4008.label: Numbers 10:20
4008.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Gad there was E·liʹa·saph the son of Deuʹel.

4009.label: Numbers 10:21
4009.text: And the Koʹhath·ites as carriers of the sanctuary pulled away, as they will have set up the tabernacle by the time of their coming.

4010.label: Numbers 10:22
4010.text: And the [three-tribe] division of the camp of the sons of Eʹphra·im pulled away in their armies, and E·lishʹa·ma the son of Am·miʹhud was over its army.

4011.label: Numbers 10:23
4011.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh there was Ga·maʹli·el the son of Pe·dahʹzur.

4012.label: Numbers 10:24
4012.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin there was Abʹi·dan the son of Gid·e·oʹni.

4013.label: Numbers 10:25
4013.text: And the [three-tribe] division of the camp of the sons of Dan pulled away as forming the rear guard for all the camps in their armies, and A·hi·eʹzer the son of Am·mi·shadʹdai was over its army.

4014.label: Numbers 10:26
4014.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Ashʹer there was Paʹgi·el the son of Ochʹran.

4015.label: Numbers 10:27
4015.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Naphʹta·li there was A·hiʹra the son of Eʹnan.

4016.label: Numbers 10:28
4016.text: In this manner were the departures of the sons of Israel in their armies when they would pull away.

4017.label: Numbers 10:29
4017.text: Then Moses said to Hoʹbab the son of Reuʹel the Midʹi·an·ite, the father-in-law of Moses: “We are pulling away for the place about which Jehovah said, ‘I shall give it to YOU.’ Do come with us, and we shall certainly do good to you, because Jehovah has spoken good concerning Israel.”

4018.label: Numbers 10:30
4018.text: But he said to him: “I shall not go along, but I shall go to my own country and to my relatives.”

4019.label: Numbers 10:31
4019.text: At this he said: “Please, do not leave us, because, for the reason that you well know where we may encamp in the wilderness, you must serve as eyes for us.

4020.label: Numbers 10:32
4020.text: And it must occur that in case you should come with us, yes, it must occur that with what goodness Jehovah will do good with us, we, in turn, will do good to you.”

4021.label: Numbers 10:33
4021.text: So they went marching from the mountain of Jehovah for a journey of three days, and the ark of Jehovah’s covenant was marching before them for a journey of three days to search out a resting-place for them.

4022.label: Numbers 10:34
4022.text: And Jehovah’s cloud was over them by day at their marching out from the encampment.

4023.label: Numbers 10:35
4023.text: And it would occur that when the Ark would set out, Moses would say: “Do arise, O Jehovah, and let your enemies be scattered; and let those who intensely hate you flee from before you.”

4024.label: Numbers 10:36
4024.text: And when it would rest, he would say: “Do return, O Jehovah, to the myriads of thousands of Israel.”

4025.label: Numbers 11:1
4025.text: Now the people became as men having something evil to complain about in the ears of Jehovah. When Jehovah got to hear it, then his anger grew hot, and a fire of Jehovah began to blaze against them and to consume some in the extremity of the camp.

4026.label: Numbers 11:2
4026.text: When the people began to cry out to Moses, then he made supplication to Jehovah, and the fire sank down.

4027.label: Numbers 11:3
4027.text: And the name of that place got to be called Tabʹe·rah, because a fire of Jehovah had blazed against them.

4028.label: Numbers 11:4
4028.text: And the mixed crowd that was in the midst of them expressed selfish longing, and the sons of Israel too began to weep again and say: “Who will give us meat to eat?

4029.label: Numbers 11:5
4029.text: How we remember the fish that we used to eat in Egypt for nothing, the cucumbers and the watermelons and the leeks and the onions and the garlic!

4030.label: Numbers 11:6
4030.text: But now our soul is dried away. Our eyes are on nothing at all except the manna.”

4031.label: Numbers 11:7
4031.text: Incidentally, the manna was like coriander seed, and its look was like the look of bdellium gum.

4032.label: Numbers 11:8
4032.text: The people spread out and picked it up and ground it in hand mills or pounded it in a mortar, and they boiled it in cooking pots or made it into round cakes, and its taste proved to be like the taste of an oiled sweet cake.

4033.label: Numbers 11:9
4033.text: And when the dew descended upon the camp by night, the manna would descend upon it.

4034.label: Numbers 11:10
4034.text: And Moses got to hear the people weeping in their families, each man at the entrance of his tent. And Jehovah’s anger began growing very hot, and in the eyes of Moses it was bad.

4035.label: Numbers 11:11
4035.text: Then Moses said to Jehovah: “Why have you caused evil to your servant, and why have I not found favor in your eyes, in placing the load of all this people upon me?

4036.label: Numbers 11:12
4036.text: Have I myself conceived all this people? Is it I who have given them birth, so that you should say to me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, just as the male nurse carries the suckling,’ to the soil about which you swore to their forefathers?

4037.label: Numbers 11:13
4037.text: From where do I have meat to give to all this people? For they keep weeping toward me, saying, ‘Do give us meat, and let us eat!’

4038.label: Numbers 11:14
4038.text: I am not able, I by myself, to carry all this people, because they are too heavy for me.

4039.label: Numbers 11:15
4039.text: So if this is the way you are doing to me, please kill me off altogether, if I have found favor in your eyes, and let me not look upon my calamity.”

4040.label: Numbers 11:16
4040.text: In turn Jehovah said to Moses: “Gather for me seventy men of the older men of Israel, whom you do know that they are older men of the people and officers of theirs, and you must take them to the tent of meeting, and they must station themselves there with you.

4041.label: Numbers 11:17
4041.text: And I shall have to come down and speak with you there; and I shall have to take away some of the spirit that is upon you and place it upon them, and they will have to help you in carrying the load of the people that you may not carry it, just you alone.

4042.label: Numbers 11:18
4042.text: And to the people you should say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, as YOU will certainly eat meat, because YOU have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying: “Who will give us meat to eat, for it was well with us in Egypt?” And Jehovah will certainly give YOU meat, and YOU will indeed eat.

4043.label: Numbers 11:19
4043.text: YOU will eat, not one day nor two days nor five days nor ten days nor twenty days,

4044.label: Numbers 11:20
4044.text: but up to a month of days, until it comes out of YOUR nostrils and it has become a loathing to YOU, just because YOU rejected Jehovah, who is in YOUR midst, and YOU went weeping before him, saying: “Why is it that we have come out of Egypt?”’”

4045.label: Numbers 11:21
4045.text: Then Moses said: “The people in the midst of whom I am are six hundred thousand men on foot, and yet you—you have said, ‘Meat I shall give them, and they will certainly eat for a month of days’!

4046.label: Numbers 11:22
4046.text: Will flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, for it to be adequate for them? Or will all the fish of the sea be caught for them, for it to be adequate for them?”

4047.label: Numbers 11:23
4047.text: At this Jehovah said to Moses: “The hand of Jehovah is cut short, is it? Now you will see whether what I say befalls you or not.”

4048.label: Numbers 11:24
4048.text: After that Moses went out and spoke to the people the words of Jehovah. And he went gathering seventy men from the older men of the people and proceeded to have them stand round about the tent.

4049.label: Numbers 11:25
4049.text: Then Jehovah came down in a cloud and spoke to him and took away some of the spirit that was upon him and put it upon each of the seventy older men. And it came about that as soon as the spirit settled down upon them, then they proceeded to act as prophets; but they did not do it again.

4050.label: Numbers 11:26
4050.text: Now there were two of the men remaining in the camp. The name of the one was Elʹdad, and the name of the other was Meʹdad. And the spirit began to settle down upon them, as they were among those written down, but they had not gone out to the tent. So they proceeded to act as prophets in the camp.

4051.label: Numbers 11:27
4051.text: And a young man went running and reporting to Moses and saying: “Elʹdad and Meʹdad are acting as prophets in the camp!”

4052.label: Numbers 11:28
4052.text: Then Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses from his young manhood on, responded and said: “My lord Moses, restrain them!”

4053.label: Numbers 11:29
4053.text: However, Moses said to him: “Are you feeling jealous for me? No, I wish that all of Jehovah’s people were prophets, because Jehovah would put his spirit upon them!”

4054.label: Numbers 11:30
4054.text: Later Moses withdrew to the camp, he and the older men of Israel.

4055.label: Numbers 11:31
4055.text: And a wind burst forth from Jehovah and began driving quails from the sea and letting them fall above the camp about a day’s journey this way and about a day’s journey that way, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

4056.label: Numbers 11:32
4056.text: Then the people got up all that day and all night and all the next day and kept gathering the quail. The one collecting least gathered ten hoʹmers, and they kept spreading them extensively all around the camp for themselves.

4057.label: Numbers 11:33
4057.text: The meat was yet between their teeth, before it could be chewed, when Jehovah’s anger blazed against the people, and Jehovah began striking at the people with a very great slaughter.

4058.label: Numbers 11:34
4058.text: The name of that place came to be called Kibʹroth-hat·taʹa·vah, because there they buried the people who showed selfish craving.

4059.label: Numbers 11:35
4059.text: From Kibʹroth-hat·taʹa·vah the people pulled away for Ha·zeʹroth, and they continued in Ha·zeʹroth.

4060.label: Numbers 12:1
4060.text: Now Mirʹi·am and Aaron began to speak against Moses on account of the Cushʹite wife whom he had taken, because it was a Cushʹite wife he had taken.

4061.label: Numbers 12:2
4061.text: And they kept saying: “Is it just by Moses alone that Jehovah has spoken? Is it not by us also that he has spoken?” And Jehovah was listening.

4062.label: Numbers 12:3
4062.text: And the man Moses was by far the meekest of all the men who were upon the surface of the ground.

4063.label: Numbers 12:4
4063.text: Then Jehovah suddenly said to Moses and Aaron and Mirʹi·am: “Go out, the three of YOU, to the tent of meeting.” So the three of them went out.

4064.label: Numbers 12:5
4064.text: After that Jehovah came down in the pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent and called Aaron and Mirʹi·am. At this both of them went out.

4065.label: Numbers 12:6
4065.text: And he went on to say: “Hear my words, please. If there came to be a prophet of YOURS for Jehovah, it would be in a vision I would make myself known to him. In a dream I would speak to him.

4066.label: Numbers 12:7
4066.text: Not so my servant Moses! He is being entrusted with all my house.

4067.label: Numbers 12:8
4067.text: Mouth to mouth I speak to him, thus showing him, and not by riddles; and the appearance of Jehovah is what he beholds. Why, then, did YOU not fear to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

4068.label: Numbers 12:9
4068.text: And Jehovah’s anger got to be hot against them, and he went his way.

4069.label: Numbers 12:10
4069.text: And the cloud turned away from over the tent, and, look! Mirʹi·am was struck with leprosy as white as snow. Then Aaron turned toward Mirʹi·am, and, look! she was struck with leprosy.

4070.label: Numbers 12:11
4070.text: Immediately Aaron said to Moses: “Excuse me, my lord! Do not, please, attribute to us the sin in which we have acted foolishly and which we have committed!

4071.label: Numbers 12:12
4071.text: Please, do not let her continue like someone dead, whose flesh at the time of his coming out of his mother’s womb is half eaten off!”

4072.label: Numbers 12:13
4072.text: And Moses began to cry out to Jehovah, saying: “O God, please! Heal her, please!”

4073.label: Numbers 12:14
4073.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Were her father to spit directly in her face, would she not be humiliated seven days? Let her be quarantined seven days outside the camp, and afterward let her be received in.”

4074.label: Numbers 12:15
4074.text: Accordingly Mirʹi·am was quarantined outside the camp seven days, and the people did not pull away until Mirʹi·am was received in.

4075.label: Numbers 12:16
4075.text: And afterward the people pulled away from Ha·zeʹroth and took up camping in the wilderness of Paʹran.

4076.label: Numbers 13:1
4076.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses, saying:

4077.label: Numbers 13:2
4077.text: “Send out for yourself men that they may spy out the land of Caʹnaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel. YOU will send out one man for each tribe of his fathers, each one a chieftain among them.”

4078.label: Numbers 13:3
4078.text: So Moses sent them out from the wilderness of Paʹran at the order of Jehovah. All the men were heads of the sons of Israel.

4079.label: Numbers 13:4
4079.text: And these are their names: Of the tribe of Reuʹben, Sham·muʹa the son of Zacʹcur;

4080.label: Numbers 13:5
4080.text: of the tribe of Simʹe·on, Shaʹphat the son of Hoʹri;

4081.label: Numbers 13:6
4081.text: of the tribe of Judah, Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh;

4082.label: Numbers 13:7
4082.text: of the tribe of Isʹsa·char, Iʹgal the son of Joseph;

4083.label: Numbers 13:8
4083.text: of the tribe of Eʹphra·im, Ho·sheʹa the son of Nun;

4084.label: Numbers 13:9
4084.text: of the tribe of Benjamin, Palʹti the son of Raʹphu;

4085.label: Numbers 13:10
4085.text: of the tribe of Zebʹu·lun, Gadʹdi·el the son of Soʹdi;

4086.label: Numbers 13:11
4086.text: of the tribe of Joseph, for the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, Gadʹdi the son of Suʹsi;

4087.label: Numbers 13:12
4087.text: of the tribe of Dan, Amʹmi·el the son of Ge·malʹli;

4088.label: Numbers 13:13
4088.text: of the tribe of Ashʹer, Seʹthur the son of Miʹcha·el;

4089.label: Numbers 13:14
4089.text: of the tribe of Naphʹta·li, Nahʹbi the son of Vophʹsi;

4090.label: Numbers 13:15
4090.text: of the tribe of Gad, Geuʹel the son of Maʹchi.

4091.label: Numbers 13:16
4091.text: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses continued to call Ho·sheʹa the son of Nun Je·hoshʹu·a.

4092.label: Numbers 13:17
4092.text: When Moses was sending them to spy out the land of Caʹnaan, he proceeded to say to them: “Go up here into the Negʹeb, and YOU must go up into the mountainous region.

4093.label: Numbers 13:18
4093.text: And YOU must see what the land is and the people who are dwelling on it, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

4094.label: Numbers 13:19
