4094.text: and what the land is in which they are dwelling, whether it is good or bad, and what the cities are in which they are dwelling, whether it is in encampments or in fortifications;

4095.label: Numbers 13:20
4095.text: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there are trees in it or not. And YOU must show yourselves courageous and take some of the fruitage of the land.” Now the days were the days of the first ripe fruits of the grapes.

4096.label: Numbers 13:21
4096.text: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Reʹhob to the entering in of Haʹmath.

4097.label: Numbers 13:22
4097.text: When they went up into the Negʹeb, they then came to Heʹbron. Now A·hiʹman, Sheʹshai and Talʹmai, those born of Aʹnak, were there. Incidentally, Heʹbron had been built seven years before Zoʹan of Egypt.

4098.label: Numbers 13:23
4098.text: When they came to the torrent valley of Eshʹcol, they then proceeded to cut down from there a shoot with one cluster of grapes. And they went carrying it with a bar on two of the men, and also some of the pomegranates and some of the figs.

4099.label: Numbers 13:24
4099.text: They called that place the torrent valley of Eshʹcol, on account of the cluster that the sons of Israel cut down from there.

4100.label: Numbers 13:25
4100.text: Finally at the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land.

4101.label: Numbers 13:26
4101.text: So they walked and came to Moses and Aaron and all the assembly of the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Paʹran, at Kaʹdesh. And they came bringing back word to them and all the assembly and showing them the fruitage of the land.

4102.label: Numbers 13:27
4102.text: And they went on to report to him and say: “We entered into the land to which you sent us out, and it is indeed flowing with milk and honey, and this is its fruitage.

4103.label: Numbers 13:28
4103.text: Nevertheless, the facts are that the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the fortified cities are very great; and, too, those born of Aʹnak we saw there.

4104.label: Numbers 13:29
4104.text: The A·malʹek·ites are dwelling in the land of the Negʹeb, and the Hitʹtites and the Jebʹu·sites and the Amʹor·ites are dwelling in the mountainous region, and the Caʹnaan·ites are dwelling by the sea and by the side of the Jordan.”

4105.label: Numbers 13:30
4105.text: Then Caʹleb tried to still the people toward Moses and went on to say: “Let us go up directly, and we are bound to take possession of it, because we can surely prevail over it.”

4106.label: Numbers 13:31
4106.text: But the men who went up with him said: “We are not able to go up against the people, because they are stronger than we are.”

4107.label: Numbers 13:32
4107.text: And they kept on bringing forth to the sons of Israel a bad report of the land that they had spied out, saying: “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people whom we saw in the midst of it are men of extraordinary size.

4108.label: Numbers 13:33
4108.text: And there we saw the Nephʹi·lim, the sons of Aʹnak, who are from the Nephʹi·lim; so that we became in our own eyes like grasshoppers, and the same way we became in their eyes.”

4109.label: Numbers 14:1
4109.text: Then all the assembly raised their voice, and the people continued giving vent to their voice and weeping all through that night.

4110.label: Numbers 14:2
4110.text: And all the sons of Israel began to murmur against Moses and Aaron, and all the assembly began to say against them: “If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!

4111.label: Numbers 14:3
4111.text: And why is Jehovah bringing us to this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become plunder. Is it not better for us to return to Egypt?”

4112.label: Numbers 14:4
4112.text: They even went to saying to one another: “Let us appoint a head, and let us return to Egypt!”

4113.label: Numbers 14:5
4113.text: At this Moses and Aaron fell upon their faces before all the congregation of the assembly of the sons of Israel.

4114.label: Numbers 14:6
4114.text: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh, who were of those who spied out the land, ripped their garments apart,

4115.label: Numbers 14:7
4115.text: and they proceeded to say this to all the assembly of the sons of Israel: “The land that we passed through to spy it out is a very, very good land.

4116.label: Numbers 14:8
4116.text: If Jehovah has found delight in us, then he will certainly bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that is flowing with milk and honey.

4117.label: Numbers 14:9
4117.text: Only against Jehovah do not rebel; and YOU, do not YOU fear the people of the land, for they are bread to us. Their shelter has turned away from over them, and Jehovah is with us. Do not fear them.”

4118.label: Numbers 14:10
4118.text: However, all the assembly talked of pelting them with stones. And Jehovah’s glory appeared on the tent of meeting to all the sons of Israel.

4119.label: Numbers 14:11
4119.text: Finally Jehovah said to Moses: “How long will this people treat me without respect, and how long will they not put faith in me for all the signs that I performed in among them?

4120.label: Numbers 14:12
4120.text: Let me strike them with pestilence and drive them away, and let me make you a nation greater and mightier than they are.”

4121.label: Numbers 14:13
4121.text: But Moses said to Jehovah: “Then the Egyptians will be bound to hear that you by your power have led this people up out of their midst.

4122.label: Numbers 14:14
4122.text: And they will be bound to tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you are Jehovah in among this people, who has appeared face to face. You are Jehovah, and your cloud is standing over them, and you are going before them in the pillar of cloud by day and in the pillar of fire by night.

4123.label: Numbers 14:15
4123.text: Were you to put this people to death as one man, then the nations who have heard of your fame would certainly say this,

4124.label: Numbers 14:16
4124.text: ‘Because of Jehovah’s not being able to bring this people into the land about which he swore to them he proceeded to slaughter them in the wilderness.’

4125.label: Numbers 14:17
4125.text: And now, please, let your power become great, O Jehovah, just as you have spoken, saying,

4126.label: Numbers 14:18
4126.text: ‘Jehovah, slow to anger and abundant in loving-kindness, pardoning error and transgression, but by no means will he give exemption from punishment, bringing punishment for the error of the fathers upon sons, upon the third generation and upon the fourth generation.’

4127.label: Numbers 14:19
4127.text: Forgive, please, the error of this people according to the greatness of your loving-kindness, and just as you have pardoned this people from Egypt onward until now.”

4128.label: Numbers 14:20
4128.text: Then Jehovah said: “I do forgive according to your word.

4129.label: Numbers 14:21
4129.text: And, on the other hand, as I live, all the earth will be filled with the glory of Jehovah.

4130.label: Numbers 14:22
4130.text: But all the men who have been seeing my glory and my signs that I have performed in Egypt and in the wilderness and yet kept testing me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice,

4131.label: Numbers 14:23
4131.text: will never see the land about which I swore to their fathers, yes, all those treating me without respect will not see it.

4132.label: Numbers 14:24
4132.text: As for my servant Caʹleb, because a different spirit has proved to be with him and he kept following wholly after me, I shall certainly bring him into the land where he has gone, and his offspring will take possession of it.

4133.label: Numbers 14:25
4133.text: While the A·malʹek·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites are dwelling in the low plain, YOU people make a turn tomorrow and pull away to march to the wilderness by way of the Red Sea.”

4134.label: Numbers 14:26
4134.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

4135.label: Numbers 14:27
4135.text: “How long will this evil assembly have this murmuring that they are carrying on against me? I have heard the murmurings of the sons of Israel that they are murmuring against me.

4136.label: Numbers 14:28
4136.text: Say to them, ‘“As I live,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “if I shall not do to YOU just that way as YOU have spoken in my ears!

4137.label: Numbers 14:29
4137.text: In this wilderness YOUR carcasses will fall, yes, all YOUR registered ones of all YOUR number from twenty years old upward, YOU who have murmured against me.

4138.label: Numbers 14:30
4138.text: As for YOU, YOU will not enter into the land in which I lifted up my hand [in oath] to reside with YOU, except Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

4139.label: Numbers 14:31
4139.text: “‘“And YOUR little ones who YOU said would become plunder, these also I shall certainly bring in, and they will indeed know the land that YOU have rejected.

4140.label: Numbers 14:32
4140.text: But the carcasses of YOU yourselves will fall in this wilderness.

4141.label: Numbers 14:33
4141.text: And YOUR sons will become shepherds in the wilderness forty years, and they will have to answer for YOUR acts of fornication, until YOUR carcasses come to their end in the wilderness.

4142.label: Numbers 14:34
4142.text: By the number of the days that YOU spied out the land, forty days, a day for a year, a day for a year, YOU will answer for YOUR errors forty years, as YOU must know what my being estranged means.

4143.label: Numbers 14:35
4143.text: “‘“I Jehovah have spoken if this is not what I shall do to all this evil assembly, those who have gathered together against me: In this wilderness they will come to their end, and there they will die.

4144.label: Numbers 14:36
4144.text: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land and who, when they returned, began making the whole assembly murmur against him, by bringing forth a bad report against the land,

4145.label: Numbers 14:37
4145.text: yes, the men bringing forth the bad report about the land will die by the scourge before Jehovah.

4146.label: Numbers 14:38
4146.text: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh will certainly live on, of those men who went to spy out the land.”’”

4147.label: Numbers 14:39
4147.text: When Moses proceeded to speak these words to all the sons of Israel, then the people began to mourn a great deal.

4148.label: Numbers 14:40
4148.text: Moreover, they got up early in the morning and tried to go up to the top of the mountain, saying: “Here we are, and we have to go up to the place that Jehovah mentioned. For we have sinned.”

4149.label: Numbers 14:41
4149.text: But Moses said: “Why is it that YOU are passing beyond the order of Jehovah? But that will not succeed.

4150.label: Numbers 14:42
4150.text: Do not go up, because Jehovah is not in YOUR midst, that YOU may not be defeated before YOUR enemies.

4151.label: Numbers 14:43
4151.text: For the A·malʹek·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites are there before YOU; and YOU are certain to fall by the sword, because, for the reason that YOU turned back from following Jehovah, Jehovah will not continue with YOU.”

4152.label: Numbers 14:44
4152.text: However, they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain, but the ark of Jehovah’s covenant and Moses did not move away from the midst of the camp.

4153.label: Numbers 14:45
4153.text: Then the A·malʹek·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites who were dwelling in that mountain came on down and began striking them and went scattering them as far as Horʹmah.

4154.label: Numbers 15:1
4154.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

4155.label: Numbers 15:2
4155.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘When YOU eventually come into the land of YOUR dwelling places, which I am giving YOU,

4156.label: Numbers 15:3
4156.text: and YOU must render up an offering made by fire to Jehovah, a burnt offering or a sacrifice to perform a special vow or voluntarily or during YOUR seasonal festivals, in order to make a restful odor to Jehovah, from the herd or from the flock;

4157.label: Numbers 15:4
4157.text: the one presenting his offering must also present to Jehovah a grain offering of fine flour, a tenth of an eʹphah, moistened with a fourth of a hin of oil.

4158.label: Numbers 15:5
4158.text: And you should render up wine as a drink offering, the fourth of a hin, together with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice of each male lamb.

4159.label: Numbers 15:6
4159.text: Or for a ram you should render up a grain offering of two tenths of fine flour, moistened with a third of a hin of oil.

4160.label: Numbers 15:7
4160.text: And you should present wine as a drink offering, a third of a hin, as a restful odor to Jehovah.

4161.label: Numbers 15:8
4161.text: “‘But in case you should render up a male of the herd as a burnt offering or a sacrifice to perform a special vow or communion sacrifices to Jehovah,

4162.label: Numbers 15:9
4162.text: one must also present together with the male of the herd a grain offering of three tenths of fine flour, moistened with half a hin of oil.

4163.label: Numbers 15:10
4163.text: And you should present wine as a drink offering, half a hin, as an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah.

4164.label: Numbers 15:11
4164.text: This is the way it should be done for each bull or for each ram or for one head among the male lambs or among the goats.

4165.label: Numbers 15:12
4165.text: Whatever may be the number that YOU may render up, that is the way YOU should do for each one according to the number of them.

4166.label: Numbers 15:13
4166.text: Every native should render up these in this way in presenting an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah.

4167.label: Numbers 15:14
4167.text: “‘And in case there should be residing as an alien with YOU an alien resident or one who is in YOUR midst for generations of YOU, and he must render up an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah, just as YOU should do, so he should do.

4168.label: Numbers 15:15
4168.text: YOU who are of the congregation and the alien resident who is residing as an alien will have one statute. It will be a statute to time indefinite for YOUR generations. The alien resident should prove to be the same as YOU before Jehovah.

4169.label: Numbers 15:16
4169.text: There should prove to be one law and one judicial decision for YOU and for the alien resident who is residing as an alien with YOU.’”

4170.label: Numbers 15:17
4170.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

4171.label: Numbers 15:18
4171.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘On YOUR coming into the land where I am bringing YOU,

4172.label: Numbers 15:19
4172.text: it must also occur that when YOU eat any of the bread of the land, YOU should make a contribution to Jehovah.

4173.label: Numbers 15:20
4173.text: YOU should make a contribution of the firstfruits of YOUR coarse meal as ring-shaped cakes. Like the contribution of a threshing floor is the way YOU should contribute it.

4174.label: Numbers 15:21
4174.text: Some of the firstfruits of YOUR coarse meal YOU should give as a contribution to Jehovah throughout YOUR generations.

4175.label: Numbers 15:22
4175.text: “‘Now in case YOU should make a mistake and not do all these commandments, which Jehovah has spoken to Moses,

4176.label: Numbers 15:23
4176.text: all that Jehovah has commanded YOU by means of Moses from the day that Jehovah commanded and onward for YOUR generations,

4177.label: Numbers 15:24
4177.text: it must then occur that if it has been done far from the eyes of the assembly by mistake, the whole assembly must then render up one young bull as a burnt offering for a restful odor to Jehovah, and its grain offering and its drink offering according to the regular procedure, and one kid of the goats as a sin offering.

4178.label: Numbers 15:25
4178.text: And the priest must make atonement for the whole assembly of the sons of Israel, and it must be forgiven them; because it was a mistake, and they, for their part, brought as their offering an offering made by fire to Jehovah and their sin offering before Jehovah for their mistake.

4179.label: Numbers 15:26
4179.text: And it must be forgiven the whole assembly of the sons of Israel and the alien resident who is residing as an alien in their midst, because it was by mistake on the part of all the people.

4180.label: Numbers 15:27
4180.text: “‘And if any soul should sin by mistake, then he must present a female goat in its first year for a sin offering.

4181.label: Numbers 15:28
4181.text: And the priest must make atonement for the soul who made a mistake by a sin unintentionally before Jehovah, so as to make atonement for it, and it must be forgiven him.

4182.label: Numbers 15:29
4182.text: As to the native among the sons of Israel and the alien resident who is residing as an alien in their midst, there should prove to be one law for YOU as respects doing something unintentionally.

4183.label: Numbers 15:30
4183.text: “‘But the soul that does something deliberately, whether he is a native or an alien resident, he speaking abusively of Jehovah, in that case that soul must be cut off from among his people.

4184.label: Numbers 15:31
4184.text: Because it is Jehovah’s word that he has despised and his commandment that he has broken, that soul should be cut off without fail. His own error is upon him.’”

4185.label: Numbers 15:32
4185.text: While the sons of Israel were continuing in the wilderness, they once found a man collecting pieces of wood on the sabbath day.

4186.label: Numbers 15:33
4186.text: Then those who found him collecting pieces of wood brought him up to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly.

4187.label: Numbers 15:34
4187.text: So they committed him into custody, because it had not been distinctly stated what should be done to him.

4188.label: Numbers 15:35
4188.text: In time Jehovah said to Moses: “Without fail the man should be put to death, the whole assembly pelting him with stones outside the camp.”

4189.label: Numbers 15:36
4189.text: Accordingly the whole assembly brought him forth outside the camp and pelted him with stones so that he died, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

4190.label: Numbers 15:37
4190.text: And Jehovah went on to say this to Moses:

4191.label: Numbers 15:38
4191.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them that they must make for themselves fringed edges upon the skirts of their garments throughout their generations, and they must put a blue string above the fringed edge of the skirt,

4192.label: Numbers 15:39
4192.text: ‘And it must serve as a fringed edge for YOU, and YOU must see it and remember all the commandments of Jehovah and do them, and YOU must not go about following YOUR hearts and YOUR eyes, which YOU are following in immoral intercourse.

4193.label: Numbers 15:40
4193.text: The purpose is that YOU may remember and may certainly do all my commandments and indeed prove to be holy to YOUR God.

4194.label: Numbers 15:41
4194.text: I am Jehovah YOUR God, who have brought YOU out of the land of Egypt in order to prove myself YOUR God. I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

4195.label: Numbers 16:1
4195.text: And Koʹrah the son of Izʹhar, the son of Koʹhath, the son of Leʹvi, proceeded to get up, together with Daʹthan and A·biʹram the sons of E·liʹab, and On the son of Peʹleth, the sons of Reuʹben.

4196.label: Numbers 16:2
4196.text: And they proceeded to rise up before Moses, they and two hundred and fifty men of the sons of Israel, chieftains of the assembly, summoned ones of the meeting, men of fame.

4197.label: Numbers 16:3
4197.text: So they congregated themselves against Moses and Aaron and said to them: “That is enough of YOU, because the whole assembly are all of them holy and Jehovah is in their midst. Why, then, should YOU lift yourselves up above the congregation of Jehovah?”

4198.label: Numbers 16:4
4198.text: When Moses got to hear it he at once fell upon his face.

4199.label: Numbers 16:5
4199.text: Then he spoke to Koʹrah and to his entire assembly, saying: “In the morning Jehovah will make known who belongs to him and who is holy and who must come near to him, and whoever he may choose will come near to him.

4200.label: Numbers 16:6
4200.text: Do this: Take fire holders for yourselves, Koʹrah and his entire assembly,

4201.label: Numbers 16:7
4201.text: and put fire in them and place incense upon them before Jehovah tomorrow, and it must occur that the man whom Jehovah will choose, he is the holy one. That is enough of YOU, YOU sons of Leʹvi!”

4202.label: Numbers 16:8
4202.text: And Moses went on to say to Koʹrah: “Listen, please, YOU sons of Leʹvi.

4203.label: Numbers 16:9
4203.text: Is it such a little thing for YOU men that the God of Israel has separated YOU men from the assembly of Israel to present YOU to himself to carry on the service of Jehovah’s tabernacle and to stand before the assembly to minister to them,

4204.label: Numbers 16:10
4204.text: and that he should bring you and all your brothers the sons of Leʹvi with you near? So must YOU men also try to secure the priesthood?

4205.label: Numbers 16:11
4205.text: For that reason you and all your assembly who are gathering together are against Jehovah. As for Aaron, what is he that YOU men should murmur against him?”

4206.label: Numbers 16:12
4206.text: Later Moses sent to call Daʹthan and A·biʹram the sons of E·liʹab, but they said: “We are not going to come up!

4207.label: Numbers 16:13
4207.text: Is it so little a thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to put us to death in the wilderness, that you should also try to play the prince over us to the limit?

4208.label: Numbers 16:14
4208.text: As it is, you have not brought us into any land flowing with milk and honey, that you may give us an inheritance of field and vineyard. Is it the eyes of those men that you want to bore out? We are not going to come up!”

4209.label: Numbers 16:15
4209.text: At this Moses became very angry and said to Jehovah: “Do not turn to look at their grain offering. Not one male ass have I taken away from them, nor have I harmed one of them.”

4210.label: Numbers 16:16
4210.text: Then Moses said to Koʹrah: “You and all your assembly, be present before Jehovah, you and they and Aaron, tomorrow.

4211.label: Numbers 16:17
4211.text: And take each one his fire holder, and YOU men must put incense upon them and present each one his fire holder before Jehovah, two hundred and fifty fire holders, and you and Aaron each his fire holder.”

4212.label: Numbers 16:18
4212.text: So they took each one his fire holder and put fire upon them and placed incense upon them and stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting together with Moses and Aaron.

4213.label: Numbers 16:19
4213.text: When Koʹrah got all the assembly together against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting, then Jehovah’s glory appeared to all the assembly.

4214.label: Numbers 16:20
4214.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

4215.label: Numbers 16:21
4215.text: “Separate yourselves from the midst of this assembly, that I may exterminate them in an instant.”

4216.label: Numbers 16:22
4216.text: At this they fell upon their faces and said: “O God, the God of the spirits of every sort of flesh, will just one man sin and you become indignant against the entire assembly?”

4217.label: Numbers 16:23
4217.text: In turn Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4218.label: Numbers 16:24
4218.text: “Speak to the assembly, saying, ‘Get away from around the tabernacles of Koʹrah, Daʹthan and A·biʹram!’”

4219.label: Numbers 16:25
4219.text: After that Moses got up and went to Daʹthan and A·biʹram, and the older men of Israel went with him.

4220.label: Numbers 16:26
4220.text: Then he spoke to the assembly, saying: “Turn aside, please, from before the tents of these wicked men and do not touch anything that belongs to them, that YOU may not be swept away in all their sin.”

4221.label: Numbers 16:27
4221.text: Immediately they got away from before the tabernacle of Koʹrah, Daʹthan and A·biʹram, from every side, and Daʹthan and A·biʹram came out, taking their stand at the entrance of their tents, together with their wives, and their sons and their little ones.

4222.label: Numbers 16:28
4222.text: Then Moses said: “By this YOU will know that Jehovah has sent me to do all these deeds, that it is not of my own heart:

4223.label: Numbers 16:29
4223.text: If it is according to the death of all mankind that these people will die and with the punishment of all mankind that punishment will be brought upon them, then it is not Jehovah that has sent me.

4224.label: Numbers 16:30
4224.text: But if it is something created that Jehovah will create, and the ground has to open its mouth and swallow up them and everything that belongs to them and they have to go down alive into Sheʹol, YOU will then know for certain that these men have treated Jehovah disrespectfully.”

4225.label: Numbers 16:31
4225.text: And it came about that as soon as he had finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them began to be split apart.

4226.label: Numbers 16:32
4226.text: And the earth proceeded to open its mouth and to swallow up them and their households and all humankind that belonged to Koʹrah and all the goods.

4227.label: Numbers 16:33
4227.text: So down they went, and all who belonged to them, alive into Sheʹol, and the earth went covering them over, so that they perished from the midst of the congregation.

4228.label: Numbers 16:34
4228.text: And all the Israelites who were round about them fled at the screaming of them, for they began to say: “We are afraid that the earth may swallow us up!”

4229.label: Numbers 16:35
4229.text: And a fire came out from Jehovah and proceeded to consume the two hundred and fifty men offering the incense.

4230.label: Numbers 16:36
4230.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses, saying:

4231.label: Numbers 16:37
4231.text: “Say to El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest that he should take up the fire holders from within the conflagration, ‘And you scatter the fire over there; for they are holy,

4232.label: Numbers 16:38
4232.text: even the fire holders of these men who sinned against their own souls. And they must make them into thin metal plates as an overlaying for the altar, because they presented them before Jehovah, so that they became holy; and they should serve as a sign to the sons of Israel.’”

4233.label: Numbers 16:39
4233.text: Accordingly El·e·aʹzar the priest took the copper fire holders, which those who had been burned up had presented, and they proceeded to beat them out into an overlaying for the altar,

4234.label: Numbers 16:40
4234.text: as a memorial for the sons of Israel, to the end that no strange man who is not of the offspring of Aaron should come near to make incense smoke before Jehovah, and no one might become like Koʹrah and his assembly, just as Jehovah had spoken to him by means of Moses.

4235.label: Numbers 16:41
4235.text: And directly the next day the whole assembly of the sons of Israel began to murmur against Moses and Aaron, saying: “YOU men, YOU have put Jehovah’s people to death.”

4236.label: Numbers 16:42
4236.text: And it came about that when the assembly had congregated themselves together against Moses and Aaron, they then turned toward the tent of meeting; and, look! the cloud covered it, and Jehovah’s glory began to appear.

4237.label: Numbers 16:43
4237.text: And Moses and Aaron proceeded to come before the tent of meeting.

4238.label: Numbers 16:44
4238.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4239.label: Numbers 16:45
4239.text: “YOU men, rise up from the midst of this assembly, that I may exterminate them in an instant.” At this they fell upon their faces.

4240.label: Numbers 16:46
4240.text: After that Moses said to Aaron: “Take the fire holder and put fire from upon the altar in it and put on incense and go to the assembly in a hurry and make atonement for them, because the indignation has gone out from the face of Jehovah. The plague has started!”

4241.label: Numbers 16:47
4241.text: Aaron at once took it, just as Moses had spoken, and went running into the midst of the congregation; and, look! the plague had started among the people. So he put the incense on and began making atonement for the people.

4242.label: Numbers 16:48
4242.text: And he kept standing between the dead and the living. Eventually the scourge was stopped.

4243.label: Numbers 16:49
4243.text: And those dead from the scourge amounted to fourteen thousand seven hundred, aside from those dead on account of Koʹrah.

4244.label: Numbers 16:50
4244.text: When at last Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, the scourge had been stopped.

4245.label: Numbers 17:1
4245.text: Jehovah now spoke to Moses, saying:

4246.label: Numbers 17:2
4246.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel and take from them one rod for each paternal house from all their chieftains, by the house of their fathers, twelve rods. You will write the name of each one upon his rod.

4247.label: Numbers 17:3
4247.text: And Aaron’s name you will write upon Leʹvi’s rod, because there is one rod for the head of the house of their fathers.

4248.label: Numbers 17:4
4248.text: And you must deposit them in the tent of meeting before the Testimony, where I regularly present myself to YOU.

4249.label: Numbers 17:5
4249.text: And what must occur is that the man whom I shall choose, his rod will bud, and I shall certainly make subside from against me the murmurings of the sons of Israel, which they are murmuring against YOU.”

4250.label: Numbers 17:6
4250.text: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their chieftains went giving him a rod for each chieftain, a rod for each chieftain, by the house of their fathers, twelve rods; and Aaron’s rod was in among their rods.

4251.label: Numbers 17:7
4251.text: Then Moses deposited the rods before Jehovah in the tent of the Testimony.

4252.label: Numbers 17:8
4252.text: And it came about the next day that when Moses went into the tent of the Testimony, look! Aaron’s rod for the house of Leʹvi had budded, and it was bringing forth buds and blossoming flowers and was bearing ripe almonds.

4253.label: Numbers 17:9
4253.text: Moses then brought out all the rods from before Jehovah to all the sons of Israel, and they went looking and taking each man his own rod.

4254.label: Numbers 17:10
4254.text: Subsequently Jehovah said to Moses: “Put Aaron’s rod back before the Testimony as something to be kept for a sign to the sons of rebelliousness, that their murmurings may cease from against me, that they may not die.”

4255.label: Numbers 17:11
4255.text: At once Moses did just as Jehovah had commanded him. He did just so.

4256.label: Numbers 17:12
4256.text: And the sons of Israel began to say this to Moses: “Now we are bound to expire, we are bound to perish, we are all of us bound to perish.

4257.label: Numbers 17:13
4257.text: Anyone approaching, coming near to Jehovah’s tabernacle, will die! Must we end up in expiring that way?”

4258.label: Numbers 18:1
4258.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to Aaron: “You and your sons and the house of your father with you will answer for error against the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you will answer for error against YOUR priesthood.

4259.label: Numbers 18:2
4259.text: And bring near, also, your brothers of the tribe of Leʹvi, the clan of your father, with you, that they may be joined to you and may minister to you, to both you and your sons with you, before the tent of the Testimony.

4260.label: Numbers 18:3
4260.text: And they must keep their obligation to you and their obligation to the entire tent. Only to the utensils of the holy place and to the altar they must not come near that they may not die, neither they nor YOU men.

4261.label: Numbers 18:4
4261.text: And they must be joined to you and must keep their obligation to the tent of meeting as respects all the service of the tent, and no stranger may come near to YOU men.

4262.label: Numbers 18:5
4262.text: And YOU must keep YOUR obligation to the holy place and YOUR obligation to the altar, that no further indignation may occur against the sons of Israel.

4263.label: Numbers 18:6
4263.text: And I, look! I have taken YOUR brothers, the Levites, from among the sons of Israel, as a gift for YOU, as those given to Jehovah to carry on the service of the tent of meeting.

4264.label: Numbers 18:7
4264.text: And you and your sons with you should safeguard YOUR priesthood as regards every concern of the altar and as regards what is inside the curtain; and YOU men must render service. As a service of gift I shall give YOUR priesthood, and the stranger drawing near should be put to death.”

4265.label: Numbers 18:8
4265.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Aaron: “As for me, look! I have given you the custody of the contributions made to me. Of all the holy things of the sons of Israel I have given them to you and to your sons as a portion, as an allowance to time indefinite.

4266.label: Numbers 18:9
4266.text: This should become yours out of the most holy things, out of the offering made by fire, every offering of theirs together with every grain offering of theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt offering of theirs, which they will return to me. It is something most holy for you and for your sons.

4267.label: Numbers 18:10
4267.text: In a most holy place you should eat it. Every male should eat it. It should become something holy to you.

4268.label: Numbers 18:11
4268.text: And this belongs to you: the contribution of their gift together with all the wave offerings of the sons of Israel. I have given them to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as an allowance to time indefinite. Everyone clean in your house may eat it.

4269.label: Numbers 18:12
4269.text: “All the best of the oil and all the best of the new wine and the grain, their firstfruits, which they will give to Jehovah, I have given them to you.

4270.label: Numbers 18:13
4270.text: The first ripe fruits of all that is on their land, which they will bring to Jehovah, yours it should become. Everyone clean in your house may eat it.

4271.label: Numbers 18:14
4271.text: “Every devoted thing in Israel should become yours.

4272.label: Numbers 18:15
4272.text: “Everything opening the womb, of every sort of flesh, which they will present to Jehovah, among man and among beast, should become yours. However, you should without fail redeem the firstborn of mankind; and the firstborn of the unclean beast you should redeem.

4273.label: Numbers 18:16
4273.text: And with a redemption price for it from a month old onward you should redeem it, by the estimated value, five silver shekels by the shekel of the holy place. It is twenty geʹrahs.

4274.label: Numbers 18:17
4274.text: Only the firstborn bull or firstborn male lamb or firstborn goat you should not redeem. They are something holy. Their blood you should sprinkle upon the altar, and their fat you should make smoke as an offering made by fire for a restful odor to Jehovah.

4275.label: Numbers 18:18
4275.text: And their flesh should become yours. Like the breast of the wave offering and like the right leg, it should become yours.

4276.label: Numbers 18:19
4276.text: All the holy contributions, which the sons of Israel will contribute to Jehovah, I have given to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as an allowance to time indefinite. It is a covenant of salt to time indefinite before Jehovah for you and your offspring with you.”

4277.label: Numbers 18:20
4277.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Aaron: “In their land you will not have an inheritance, and no share will become yours in their midst. I am your share and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel.

4278.label: Numbers 18:21
4278.text: “And to the sons of Leʹvi, look! I have given every tenth part in Israel as an inheritance in return for their service that they are carrying on, the service of the tent of meeting.

4279.label: Numbers 18:22
4279.text: And the sons of Israel should no more come near to the tent of meeting to incur sin so as to die.

4280.label: Numbers 18:23
4280.text: And the Levites themselves must carry on the service of the tent of meeting, and they are the ones who should answer for their error. It is a statute to time indefinite during YOUR generations that in the midst of the sons of Israel they should not get possession of an inheritance.

4281.label: Numbers 18:24
4281.text: For the tenth part of the sons of Israel, which they will contribute to Jehovah as a contribution, I have given to the Levites as an inheritance. That is why I have said to them, ‘In the midst of the sons of Israel they should not get possession of an inheritance.’”

4282.label: Numbers 18:25
4282.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4283.label: Numbers 18:26
4283.text: “And you should speak to the Levites, and you must say to them, ‘YOU will receive from the sons of Israel the tenth part that I have given to YOU from them for YOUR inheritance, and YOU must contribute from it as a contribution to Jehovah a tenth part of the tenth part.

4284.label: Numbers 18:27
4284.text: And it must be reckoned to YOU as YOUR contribution, like the grain of the threshing floor and like the full produce of the wine or oil press.

4285.label: Numbers 18:28
4285.text: In this way YOU yourselves also will contribute a contribution to Jehovah from all YOUR tenth parts that YOU will receive from the sons of Israel, and from them YOU must give the contribution to Jehovah to Aaron the priest.

4286.label: Numbers 18:29
4286.text: From all the gifts to YOU, YOU will contribute every sort of contribution to Jehovah, of the very best of it, as some holy thing from them.’

4287.label: Numbers 18:30
4287.text: “And you must say to them, ‘When YOU contribute the best of them, then it will certainly be reckoned to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the wine or oil press.

4288.label: Numbers 18:31
4288.text: And YOU must eat it in every place, YOU and YOUR household, because it is YOUR wages in return for YOUR service in the tent of meeting.

4289.label: Numbers 18:32
4289.text: And YOU must not incur sin for it when YOU contribute the best from them, and YOU must not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, that YOU may not die.’”

4290.label: Numbers 19:1
4290.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

4291.label: Numbers 19:2
4291.text: “This is a statute of the law that Jehovah has commanded, saying, ‘Speak to the sons of Israel that they should take for you a sound red cow in which there is no defect and upon which no yoke has come.

4292.label: Numbers 19:3
4292.text: And YOU must give it to El·e·aʹzar the priest, and he must lead it forth outside the camp, and it must be slaughtered before him.

4293.label: Numbers 19:4
4293.text: Then El·e·aʹzar the priest must take some of its blood with his finger and spatter some of its blood straight toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.

4294.label: Numbers 19:5
4294.text: And the cow must be burned under his eyes. Its skin and its flesh and its blood together with its dung will be burned.

4295.label: Numbers 19:6
4295.text: And the priest must take cedarwood and hyssop and coccus scarlet material and throw it into the midst of the burning of the cow.

4296.label: Numbers 19:7
4296.text: And the priest must wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp; but the priest must be unclean until the evening.

4297.label: Numbers 19:8
4297.text: “‘And the one who burned it will wash his garments in water and must bathe his flesh in water, and he must be unclean until the evening.

4298.label: Numbers 19:9
4298.text: “‘And a clean man must gather up the ashes of the cow and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place; and they must serve the assembly of the sons of Israel as something to be kept for the water for cleansing. It is a sin offering.

4299.label: Numbers 19:10
4299.text: And the one gathering the ashes of the cow must wash his garments and be unclean until the evening. “‘And it must serve the sons of Israel and the alien resident who is residing as an alien in their midst as a statute to time indefinite.

4300.label: Numbers 19:11
4300.text: Anyone touching the corpse of any human soul must also be unclean seven days.

4301.label: Numbers 19:12
4301.text: Such one should purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he will be clean. But if he will not purify himself on the third day, then on the seventh day he will not be clean.

4302.label: Numbers 19:13
4302.text: Everyone touching a corpse, the soul of whatever man may die, and who will not purify himself, has defiled Jehovah’s tabernacle, and that soul must be cut off from Israel. Because the water for cleansing has not been sprinkled upon him, he continues unclean. His uncleanness is still upon him.

4303.label: Numbers 19:14
4303.text: “‘This is the law in case a man should die in a tent: Everyone coming into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, will be unclean seven days.

4304.label: Numbers 19:15
4304.text: And every opened vessel upon which there is no lid tied down is unclean.

4305.label: Numbers 19:16
4305.text: And everyone who on the open field may touch someone slain with the sword or a corpse or a bone of a man or a burial place will be unclean seven days.

4306.label: Numbers 19:17
4306.text: And they must take for the unclean one some of the dust of the burning of the sin offering and put running water upon it in a vessel.

4307.label: Numbers 19:18
4307.text: Then a clean man must take hyssop and dip it into the water and spatter it upon the tent and all the vessels and the souls that happened to be there and upon the one who touched the bone or the slain one or the corpse or the burial place.

4308.label: Numbers 19:19
4308.text: And the clean person must spatter it upon the unclean one on the third day and on the seventh day and must purify him from sin on the seventh day; and he must wash his garments and bathe in water, and he must be clean in the evening.

4309.label: Numbers 19:20
4309.text: “‘But the man who may be unclean and who will not purify himself, well, that soul must be cut off from the midst of the congregation, because it is Jehovah’s sanctuary that he has defiled. The water for cleansing was not sprinkled upon him. He is unclean.

4310.label: Numbers 19:21
4310.text: “‘And it must serve as a statute to time indefinite for them, that the one spattering the water for cleansing should wash his garments, also the one touching the water for cleansing. He will be unclean until the evening.

4311.label: Numbers 19:22
4311.text: And anything the unclean one may touch will be unclean, and the soul who touches it will be unclean until the evening.’”

4312.label: Numbers 20:1
4312.text: And the sons of Israel, the entire assembly, proceeded to come into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people took up dwelling in Kaʹdesh. It was there that Mirʹi·am died and there that she was buried.

4313.label: Numbers 20:2
4313.text: Now there proved to be no water for the assembly, and they began to congregate themselves against Moses and Aaron.

4314.label: Numbers 20:3
4314.text: And the people went quarreling with Moses and saying: “If only we had expired when our brothers expired before Jehovah!

4315.label: Numbers 20:4
4315.text: And why have YOU men brought Jehovah’s congregation into this wilderness for us and our beasts of burden to die there?

4316.label: Numbers 20:5
4316.text: And why have YOU conducted us up out of Egypt to bring us into this evil place? It is no place of seed and figs and vines and pomegranates, and there is no water to drink.”

4317.label: Numbers 20:6
4317.text: Then Moses and Aaron came from before the congregation to the entrance of the tent of meeting and fell upon their faces, and Jehovah’s glory began to appear to them.

4318.label: Numbers 20:7
4318.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4319.label: Numbers 20:8
4319.text: “Take the rod and call the assembly together, you and Aaron your brother, and YOU must speak to the crag before their eyes that it may indeed give its water; and you must bring out water for them from the crag and give the assembly and their beasts of burden drink.”

4320.label: Numbers 20:9
4320.text: So Moses took the rod from before Jehovah, just as he had commanded him.

4321.label: Numbers 20:10
4321.text: After that Moses and Aaron called the congregation together before the crag, and he proceeded to say to them: “Hear, now, YOU rebels! Is it from this crag that we shall bring out water for YOU?”

4322.label: Numbers 20:11
4322.text: With that Moses lifted his hand up and struck the crag with his rod twice; and much water began to come out, and the assembly and their beasts of burden began to drink.

4323.label: Numbers 20:12
4323.text: Later Jehovah said to Moses and Aaron: “Because YOU did not show faith in me to sanctify me before the eyes of the sons of Israel, therefore YOU will not bring this congregation into the land that I shall certainly give them.”

4324.label: Numbers 20:13
4324.text: These are the waters of Merʹi·bah, because the sons of Israel quarreled with Jehovah, so that he was sanctified among them.

4325.label: Numbers 20:14
4325.text: Subsequently Moses sent messengers from Kaʹdesh to the king of Eʹdom: “This is what your brother Israel has said, ‘You yourself well know all the hardship that has overtaken us.

4326.label: Numbers 20:15
4326.text: And our fathers proceeded to go down to Egypt, and we continued to dwell in Egypt many days; and the Egyptians began doing harm to us and our fathers.

4327.label: Numbers 20:16
4327.text: Finally we cried out to Jehovah and he heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and here we are in Kaʹdesh, a city at the extremity of your territory.

4328.label: Numbers 20:17
4328.text: Let us pass, please, through your land. We shall not pass through a field or a vineyard, and we shall not drink the water of a well. On the king’s road we shall march. We shall not bend toward the right or the left, until we shall pass through your territory.’”

4329.label: Numbers 20:18
4329.text: However, Eʹdom said to him: “You must not pass through me, for fear I may come out with the sword to meet you.”

4330.label: Numbers 20:19
4330.text: In turn the sons of Israel said to him: “By the highway we shall go up; and if I and my livestock should drink your water, I shall also certainly give the value of it. I want nothing more than to pass through on my feet.”

4331.label: Numbers 20:20
4331.text: Still he said: “You must not pass through.” With that Eʹdom came on out to encounter him with a great many people and a strong hand.

4332.label: Numbers 20:21
4332.text: So Eʹdom refused to grant Israel to pass through his territory. Hence Israel turned away from him.

4333.label: Numbers 20:22
4333.text: And the sons of Israel, the entire assembly, proceeded to pull away from Kaʹdesh and come to Mount Hor.

4334.label: Numbers 20:23
4334.text: Then Jehovah said this to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor by the border of the land of Eʹdom:

4335.label: Numbers 20:24
4335.text: “Aaron will be gathered to his people, for he will not enter into the land that I shall certainly give to the sons of Israel, on the ground that YOU men rebelled against my order respecting the waters of Merʹi·bah.

4336.label: Numbers 20:25
4336.text: Take Aaron and El·e·aʹzar his son and bring them up into Mount Hor.

4337.label: Numbers 20:26
4337.text: And strip Aaron of his garments, and you must clothe with them El·e·aʹzar his son; and Aaron will be gathered and must die there.”

4338.label: Numbers 20:27
4338.text: So Moses did just as Jehovah had commanded; and before the eyes of all the assembly they went climbing Mount Hor.

4339.label: Numbers 20:28
4339.text: Then Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and clothed El·e·aʹzar his son with them, after which Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. And Moses and El·e·aʹzar came on down from the mountain.

4340.label: Numbers 20:29
4340.text: And all the assembly got to see that Aaron had expired, and all the house of Israel continued weeping for Aaron thirty days.

4341.label: Numbers 21:1
4341.text: Now the Caʹnaan·ite the king of Aʹrad, who dwelt in the Negʹeb, got to hear that Israel had come by the way of Athʹa·rim, and he began to fight with Israel and carry away some of them as captives.

4342.label: Numbers 21:2
4342.text: Consequently Israel made a vow to Jehovah and said: “If you will without fail give this people into my hand, I shall also certainly devote their cities to destruction.”

4343.label: Numbers 21:3
4343.text: So Jehovah listened to Israel’s voice and gave the Caʹnaan·ites over; and they devoted them and their cities to destruction. Hence they called the name of the place Horʹmah.

4344.label: Numbers 21:4
4344.text: While they continued trekking from Mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea to go around the land of Eʹdom, the soul of the people began tiring out because of the way.

4345.label: Numbers 21:5
4345.text: And the people kept speaking against God and Moses: “Why have YOU brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread and no water, and our soul has come to abhor the contemptible bread.”

4346.label: Numbers 21:6
4346.text: So Jehovah sent poisonous serpents among the people, and they kept biting the people, so that many people of Israel died.

4347.label: Numbers 21:7
4347.text: Finally the people came to Moses and said: “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Jehovah and against you. Intercede with Jehovah that he may remove the serpents from upon us.” And Moses went interceding in behalf of the people.

4348.label: Numbers 21:8
4348.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Make for yourself a fiery snake and place it upon a signal pole. And it must occur that when anyone has been bitten, he then has to look at it and so must keep alive.”

4349.label: Numbers 21:9
4349.text: Moses at once made a serpent of copper and placed it upon the signal pole; and it did occur that if a serpent had bitten a man and he gazed at the copper serpent, he then kept alive.

4350.label: Numbers 21:10
4350.text: After that the sons of Israel pulled away and encamped in Oʹboth.

4351.label: Numbers 21:11
4351.text: Then they pulled away from Oʹboth and encamped in Iʹye-abʹa·rim, in the wilderness that is toward the front of Moʹab, toward the rising of the sun.

4352.label: Numbers 21:12
4352.text: From there they pulled away and took up camping by the torrent valley of Zeʹred.

4353.label: Numbers 21:13
4353.text: From there they pulled away and went camping in the region of the Arʹnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amʹor·ites; for the Arʹnon is the boundary of Moʹab, between Moʹab and the Amʹor·ites.

4354.label: Numbers 21:14
4354.text: That is why it is said in the book of the Wars of Jehovah: “Vaʹheb in Suʹphah and the torrent valleys of Arʹnon,

4355.label: Numbers 21:15
4355.text: and the mouth of the torrent valleys, which has bent itself toward the seat of Ar and has leaned against the border of Moʹab.”

4356.label: Numbers 21:16
4356.text: Next from there on to Beʹer. This is the well about which Jehovah said to Moses: “Gather the people, and let me give them water.”

4357.label: Numbers 21:17
4357.text: At that time Israel proceeded to sing this song: “Spring up, O well! Respond to it, YOU people!

4358.label: Numbers 21:18
4358.text: A well, princes dug it. The nobles of the people excavated it,With a commander’s staff, with their own staffs.” Then from the wilderness on to Matʹta·nah.

4359.label: Numbers 21:19
4359.text: And from Matʹta·nah on to Na·halʹi·el, and from Na·halʹi·el on to Baʹmoth.

4360.label: Numbers 21:20
4360.text: And from Baʹmoth on to the valley that is in the field of Moʹab, at the head of Pisʹgah, and it projects over toward the face of Je·shiʹmon.

4361.label: Numbers 21:21
4361.text: Israel now sent messengers to Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, saying:

4362.label: Numbers 21:22
4362.text: “Let me pass through your land. We shall not turn off into a field or a vineyard. We shall drink water of no well. On the king’s road we shall march until we pass through your territory.”

4363.label: Numbers 21:23
4363.text: And Siʹhon did not allow Israel to pass through his territory, but Siʹhon gathered all his people and went out to meet Israel in the wilderness, and came to Jaʹhaz and began fighting with Israel.

4364.label: Numbers 21:24
4364.text: At that Israel struck him with the edge of the sword and took possession of his land from the Arʹnon to the Jabʹbok, near the sons of Amʹmon; because Jaʹzer is the border of the sons of Amʹmon.

4365.label: Numbers 21:25
4365.text: So Israel took all these cities, and Israel began dwelling in all the cities of the Amʹor·ites, in Heshʹbon and all its dependent towns.

4366.label: Numbers 21:26
4366.text: For Heshʹbon was the city of Siʹhon. He was the king of the Amʹor·ites, and it was he who fought with the king of Moʹab formerly and went taking all his land out of his hand as far as the Arʹnon.

4367.label: Numbers 21:27
4367.text: That is why the sayers of mock verses would say: “Come to Heshʹbon.Let the city of Siʹhon be built and be proved firmly set up.

4368.label: Numbers 21:28
4368.text: For a fire has come out of Heshʹbon, a flame from the town of Siʹhon.It has consumed Ar of Moʹab, the owners of the high places of the Arʹnon.

4369.label: Numbers 21:29
4369.text: Woe to you, Moʹab! You will certainly perish, O people of Cheʹmosh! He will certainly give his sons as escaped ones and his daughters in the captivity to the king of the Amʹor·ites, Siʹhon.

4370.label: Numbers 21:30
4370.text: So let us shoot at them.Heshʹbon will certainly perish up to Diʹbon, And the women up to Noʹphah, the men up to Medʹe·ba.”

4371.label: Numbers 21:31
4371.text: And Israel began to dwell in the land of the Amʹor·ites.

4372.label: Numbers 21:32
4372.text: Then Moses sent some to spy on Jaʹzer. So they captured its dependent towns and dispossessed the Amʹor·ites who were there.

4373.label: Numbers 21:33
4373.text: After that they turned and went up by the way of Baʹshan. At this Og the king of Baʹshan came out to meet them, he and all his people, to the battle of Edʹre·i.

4374.label: Numbers 21:34
4374.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Do not be afraid of him, for into your hand I shall certainly give him and all his people and his land; and you must do to him just as you did to Siʹhon, the king of the Amʹor·ites, who used to dwell in Heshʹbon.”

4375.label: Numbers 21:35
4375.text: So they went striking him and his sons and all his people, until there was no survivor remaining to him; and they went taking possession of his land.

4376.label: Numbers 22:1
4376.text: Then the sons of Israel pulled away and encamped on the desert plains of Moʹab across the Jordan from Jerʹi·cho.

4377.label: Numbers 22:2
4377.text: And Baʹlak the son of Zipʹpor got to see all that Israel had done to the Amʹor·ites.

4378.label: Numbers 22:3
4378.text: And Moʹab became very frightened at the people, because they were many; and Moʹab began to feel a sickening dread of the sons of Israel.

4379.label: Numbers 22:4
4379.text: And Moʹab proceeded to say to the older men of Midʹi·an: “Now this congregation will lick up all our surroundings like the bull licking up the green growth of the field.” And Baʹlak the son of Zipʹpor was king of Moʹab at that particular time.

4380.label: Numbers 22:5
4380.text: He now sent messengers to Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor at Peʹthor, which is by the River of the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying: “Look! A people has come out of Egypt. Look! They have covered the earth as far as one can see, and they are dwelling right in front of me.

4381.label: Numbers 22:6
4381.text: And now do come, please; do curse this people for me, for they are mightier than I am. Perhaps I may be able to strike them and I may drive them out of the land; for I well know that the one whom you bless is a blessed one and the one whom you curse is cursed.”

4382.label: Numbers 22:7
4382.text: So the older men of Moʹab and the older men of Midʹi·an traveled with the payments for divination in their hands and went to Baʹlaam and spoke to him Baʹlak’s words.

4383.label: Numbers 22:8
4383.text: At that he said to them: “Lodge here tonight, and I shall certainly return YOU word just as Jehovah may speak to me.” Accordingly the princes of Moʹab stayed with Baʹlaam.

4384.label: Numbers 22:9
4384.text: Then God came to Baʹlaam and said: “Who are these men with you?”

4385.label: Numbers 22:10
4385.text: So Baʹlaam said to the [true] God: “Baʹlak the son of Zipʹpor, the king of Moʹab, has sent to me, saying,

4386.label: Numbers 22:11
4386.text: ‘Look! The people who are coming out of Egypt, and they go covering the earth as far as the eye can see. Now do come, do execrate them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and I shall actually drive them out.’”

4387.label: Numbers 22:12
4387.text: But God said to Baʹlaam: “You must not go with them. You must not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

4388.label: Numbers 22:13
4388.text: After that Baʹlaam got up in the morning and said to the princes of Baʹlak: “Go to YOUR country, because Jehovah has refused to let me go with YOU.”

4389.label: Numbers 22:14
4389.text: So the princes of Moʹab got up and came to Baʹlak and said: “Baʹlaam has refused to come with us.”

4390.label: Numbers 22:15
4390.text: However, Baʹlak sent again other princes in greater number and more honorable than the former.

4391.label: Numbers 22:16
4391.text: In turn they came to Baʹlaam and said to him: “This is what Baʹlak the son of Zipʹpor has said, ‘Do not be detained, please, from coming to me.

4392.label: Numbers 22:17
4392.text: For I shall without fail honor you greatly, and everything you may say to me I shall do. So do come, please. Do execrate this people for me.’”

4393.label: Numbers 22:18
4393.text: But Baʹlaam answered and said to the servants of Baʹlak: “If Baʹlak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I should not be able to pass beyond the order of Jehovah my God, so as to do something small or great.

4394.label: Numbers 22:19
4394.text: And now YOU men also stay here, please, tonight that I may know what further Jehovah will speak with me.”

4395.label: Numbers 22:20
4395.text: Then God came to Baʹlaam by night and said to him: “If it is to call you that the men have come, get up, go with them. But only the word that I shall speak to you is what you may speak.”

4396.label: Numbers 22:21
4396.text: After that Baʹlaam got up in the morning and saddled his she-ass and went with the princes of Moʹab.

4397.label: Numbers 22:22
4397.text: And the anger of God began to blaze because he was going; and Jehovah’s angel proceeded to station himself in the road to resist him. And he was riding upon his she-ass, and two attendants of his were with him.

4398.label: Numbers 22:23
4398.text: And the ass got to see Jehovah’s angel stationed in the road with his drawn sword in his hand; and the ass tried to turn aside from the road that she might go into the field, but Baʹlaam began to strike the ass in order to turn her aside to the road.

4399.label: Numbers 22:24
4399.text: And Jehovah’s angel kept standing in the narrow way between the vineyards, with a stone wall on this side and a stone wall on that side.

4400.label: Numbers 22:25
4400.text: And the she-ass kept seeing Jehovah’s angel and began to squeeze herself against the wall and so to squeeze Baʹlaam’s foot against the wall; and he went beating her some more.

4401.label: Numbers 22:26
4401.text: Jehovah’s angel now passed by again and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn aside to the right or the left.

4402.label: Numbers 22:27
4402.text: When the ass got to see Jehovah’s angel she now lay down under Baʹlaam; so that Baʹlaam’s anger blazed, and he kept beating the ass with his staff.

4403.label: Numbers 22:28
4403.text: Finally Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass and she said to Baʹlaam: “What have I done to you so that you have beaten me these three times?”

4404.label: Numbers 22:29
4404.text: At this Baʹlaam said to the ass: “It is because you have dealt ruthlessly with me. If only there were a sword in my hand, for now I should have killed you!”

4405.label: Numbers 22:30
4405.text: Then the she-ass said to Baʹlaam: “Am I not your she-ass that you have ridden upon all your life long until this day? Have I ever been used to do to you this way?” To which he said: “No!”

4406.label: Numbers 22:31
4406.text: And Jehovah proceeded to uncover Baʹlaam’s eyes, so that he saw Jehovah’s angel stationed in the road with his drawn sword in his hand. At once he bowed low and prostrated himself on his face.

4407.label: Numbers 22:32
4407.text: Then Jehovah’s angel said to him: “Why have you beaten your she-ass these three times? Look! I—I have come out to offer resistance, because your way has been headlong against my will.

4408.label: Numbers 22:33
4408.text: And the she-ass got to see me and tried to turn aside before me these three times. Supposing she had not turned aside from before me! For by now even you I should have killed, but her I should have preserved alive.”

4409.label: Numbers 22:34
4409.text: At this Baʹlaam said to Jehovah’s angel: “I have sinned, because I did not know that it was you stationed in the road to meet me. And now, if it is bad in your eyes, let me go my way back.”

4410.label: Numbers 22:35
4410.text: But Jehovah’s angel said to Baʹlaam: “Go with the men; and nothing but the word that I shall speak to you is what you may speak.” And Baʹlaam continued going with the princes of Baʹlak.

4411.label: Numbers 22:36
4411.text: When Baʹlak got to hear that Baʹlaam had come, he at once went out to meet him at the city of Moʹab, which is on the bank of the Arʹnon, which is on the extremity of the territory.

4412.label: Numbers 22:37
4412.text: Then Baʹlak said to Baʹlaam: “Have I not for a fact sent to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not really and truly able to honor you?”

4413.label: Numbers 22:38
4413.text: At this Baʹlaam said to Baʹlak: “Here I have come to you now. Shall I be able at all to speak something? The word that God will place in my mouth is what I shall speak.”

4414.label: Numbers 22:39
4414.text: So Baʹlaam went with Baʹlak and they came to Kirʹi·ath-huʹzoth.

4415.label: Numbers 22:40
4415.text: And Baʹlak proceeded to sacrifice cattle and sheep and to send some to Baʹlaam and the princes who were with him.

4416.label: Numbers 22:41
4416.text: And it came about in the morning that Baʹlak went taking Baʹlaam and bringing him up to Baʹmoth-baʹal, that he might see from there the whole of the people.

4417.label: Numbers 23:1
4417.text: Then Baʹlaam said to Baʹlak: “Build for me on this spot seven altars and make ready for me on this spot seven bulls and seven rams.”

4418.label: Numbers 23:2
4418.text: Baʹlak immediately did just as Baʹlaam had spoken. After that Baʹlak and Baʹlaam offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.

4419.label: Numbers 23:3
4419.text: And Baʹlaam went on to say to Baʹlak: “Station yourself by your burnt offering, and let me go. Perhaps Jehovah will get in touch and meet with me. In that case whatever he will show me, I shall certainly tell you.” So he went to a bare hill.

4420.label: Numbers 23:4
4420.text: When God got in touch with Baʹlaam, he then said to Him: “I set the seven altars in rows, and I proceeded to offer up a bull and a ram on each altar.”

4421.label: Numbers 23:5
4421.text: Accordingly Jehovah put a word in the mouth of Baʹlaam and said: “Return to Baʹlak, and this is what you will speak.”

4422.label: Numbers 23:6
4422.text: So he returned to him, and, look! he and all the princes of Moʹab were stationed by his burnt offering.

4423.label: Numbers 23:7
4423.text: Then he took up his proverbial utterance and said: “From Aʹram Baʹlak the king of Moʹab tried to conduct me,From the mountains of the east:‘Do come, do curse Jacob for me.Yes, do come, do denounce Israel.’

4424.label: Numbers 23:8
4424.text: How could I execrate those whom God has not execrated? And how could I denounce those whom Jehovah has not denounced?

4425.label: Numbers 23:9
4425.text: For from the top of the rocks I see them, And from the hills I behold them.There as a people they keep tabernacling isolated, And among the nations they do not reckon themselves.

4426.label: Numbers 23:10
4426.text: Who has numbered the dust particles of Jacob, And who has counted the fourth part of Israel?Let my soul die the death of the upright ones, And let my end turn out afterward like theirs.”

4427.label: Numbers 23:11
4427.text: At this Baʹlak said to Baʹlaam: “What have you done to me? It was in order to execrate my enemies that I took you, and here you have blessed them to the limit.”

4428.label: Numbers 23:12
4428.text: In turn he answered and said: “Is it not whatever Jehovah may put in my mouth that I should take care to speak?”

4429.label: Numbers 23:13
4429.text: Then Baʹlak said to him: “Do come, please, with me to another place from which you can see them. Only the extremity of them you will see, and you will not see all of them. And execrate them for me from there.”

4430.label: Numbers 23:14
4430.text: So he took him to the field of Zoʹphim, to the top of Pisʹgah, and proceeded to build seven altars and to offer up a bull and a ram on each altar.

4431.label: Numbers 23:15
4431.text: After that he said to Baʹlak: “Station yourself here by your burnt offering, and, as for me, let me get in touch with him there.”

4432.label: Numbers 23:16
4432.text: Subsequently Jehovah got in touch with Baʹlaam and put a word in his mouth and said: “Return to Baʹlak, and this is what you will speak.”

4433.label: Numbers 23:17
4433.text: So he came to him, and, look! he was stationed by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moʹab with him. Then Baʹlak said to him: “What has Jehovah spoken?”

4434.label: Numbers 23:18
4434.text: At this he took up his proverbial utterance and said: “Get up, Baʹlak, and listen.Do give ear to me, O son of Zipʹpor.

4435.label: Numbers 23:19
4435.text: God is not a man that he should tell lies, Neither a son of mankind that he should feel regret. Has he himself said it and will he not do it,And has he spoken and will he not carry it out?

4436.label: Numbers 23:20
4436.text: Look! I have been taken to bless,And He has blessed, and I shall not reverse it.

4437.label: Numbers 23:21
4437.text: He has not looked upon any uncanny power against Jacob,And no trouble has he seen against Israel.Jehovah his God is with him, And the loud hailing of a king is in his midst.

4438.label: Numbers 23:22
4438.text: God is bringing them out of Egypt. The swift course like that of a wild bull is his.

4439.label: Numbers 23:23
4439.text: For there is no unlucky spell against Jacob, Nor any divination against Israel. At this time it may be said respecting Jacob and Israel,‘What has God worked out!’

4440.label: Numbers 23:24
4440.text: Behold, a people will get up like a lion, And like the lion it will lift itself up. It will not lie down until it may eat prey,And the blood of slain ones it will drink.”

4441.label: Numbers 23:25
4441.text: At this Baʹlak said to Baʹlaam: “If, on the one hand, you cannot execrate him at all, then, on the other hand, you should not bless him at all.”

4442.label: Numbers 23:26
4442.text: In turn Baʹlaam answered and said to Baʹlak: “Did I not speak to you, saying, ‘All that Jehovah will speak is what I shall do’?”

4443.label: Numbers 23:27
4443.text: Then Baʹlak said to Baʹlaam: “O come, please. Let me take you to still another place. Perhaps it will be right in the eyes of the [true] God so that you will certainly execrate him for me from there.”

4444.label: Numbers 23:28
4444.text: With that Baʹlak took Baʹlaam to the top of Peʹor, which looks toward Je·shiʹmon.

4445.label: Numbers 23:29
4445.text: Then Baʹlaam said to Baʹlak: “Build for me on this spot seven altars and make ready for me on this spot seven bulls and seven rams.”

4446.label: Numbers 23:30
4446.text: So Baʹlak did just as Baʹlaam had said, and he went offering up a bull and a ram on each altar.

4447.label: Numbers 24:1
4447.text: When Baʹlaam got to see that it was good in the eyes of Jehovah to bless Israel, he did not go away as at the other times to come upon any unlucky omens, but he directed his face to the wilderness.

4448.label: Numbers 24:2
4448.text: When Baʹlaam raised his eyes and saw Israel tabernacling by his tribes, then the spirit of God came to be upon him.

4449.label: Numbers 24:3
4449.text: Hence he took up his proverbial utterance and said: “The utterance of Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor,And the utterance of the able-bodied man with the eye unsealed,

4450.label: Numbers 24:4
4450.text: The utterance of the one hearing the sayings of God, Who got to see a vision of the Almighty While falling down with the eyes uncovered:

4451.label: Numbers 24:5
4451.text: How good-looking are your tents, O Jacob, your tabernacles, O Israel!

4452.label: Numbers 24:6
4452.text: Like torrent valleys they have extended a long way, Like gardens by the river. Like aloe plants that Jehovah has planted,Like cedars by the waters.

4453.label: Numbers 24:7
4453.text: Water keeps trickling from his two leather buckets,And his seed is by many waters. His king also will be higher than Aʹgag, And his kingdom will be lifted up.

4454.label: Numbers 24:8
4454.text: God is bringing him out of Egypt;The swift course of a wild bull is his. He will consume the nations, his oppressors, And their bones he will gnaw, and he will break them to pieces with his arrows.

4455.label: Numbers 24:9
4455.text: He bowed down, he lay down like the lion, And, like a lion, who dares rouse him? Those blessing you are the ones blessed, And those cursing you are the ones cursed.”

4456.label: Numbers 24:10
4456.text: At that Baʹlak’s anger blazed against Baʹlaam and he clapped his hands, and Baʹlak went on to say to Baʹlaam: “It was to execrate my enemies that I called you, and, look! you have blessed them to the limit these three times.

4457.label: Numbers 24:11
4457.text: And now run your way off to your place. I had said to myself I was without fail going to honor you, but, look! Jehovah has held you back from honor.”

4458.label: Numbers 24:12
4458.text: In turn Baʹlaam said to Baʹlak: “Was it not also to your messengers whom you sent to me that I spoke, saying,

4459.label: Numbers 24:13
4459.text: ‘If Baʹlak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I should not be able to pass beyond the order of Jehovah so as to do something good or bad out of my own heart. Whatever Jehovah may speak is what I shall speak’?

4460.label: Numbers 24:14
4460.text: And now here I am going away to my people. Do come, let me advise you what this people will do to your people afterward in the end of the days.”

4461.label: Numbers 24:15
4461.text: So he took up his proverbial utterance and said: “The utterance of Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor,And the utterance of the able-bodied man with the eye unsealed,

4462.label: Numbers 24:16
4462.text: The utterance of the one hearing the sayings of God, And the one knowing the knowledge of the Most High—A vision of the Almighty he got to see While falling down with the eyes uncovered:

4463.label: Numbers 24:17
4463.text: I shall see him, but not now;I shall behold him, but not near.A star will certainly step forth out of Jacob,And a scepter will indeed rise out of Israel. And he will certainly break apart the temples of Moʹab’s [head] And the cranium of all the sons of tumult of war.

4464.label: Numbers 24:18
4464.text: And Eʹdom must become a possession, Yes, Seʹir must become the possession of his enemies, While Israel is displaying his courage.

4465.label: Numbers 24:19
4465.text: And out of Jacob one will go subduing, And he must destroy any survivor from the city.”

4466.label: Numbers 24:20
4466.text: When he got to see Amʹa·lek, he carried further his proverbial utterance and went on to say: “Amʹa·lek was the first one of the nations, But his end afterward will be even his perishing.”

4467.label: Numbers 24:21
4467.text: When he got to see the Kenʹites, he carried further his proverbial utterance and went on to say: “Durable is your dwelling, and set on the crag is your abode.

4468.label: Numbers 24:22
4468.text: But there will come to be one to burn Kaʹin down.How long will it be till As·syrʹi·a will carry you away captive?”

4469.label: Numbers 24:23
4469.text: And he carried further his proverbial utterance and went on to say:“Woe! Who will survive when God causes it?

4470.label: Numbers 24:24
4470.text: And there will be ships from the coast of Kitʹtim, And they will certainly afflict As·syrʹi·a, And they will indeed afflict Eʹber. But he too will eventually perish.”

4471.label: Numbers 24:25
4471.text: After that Baʹlaam got up and went and returned to his place. And Baʹlak also went his own way.

4472.label: Numbers 25:1
4472.text: Now Israel was dwelling in Shitʹtim. Then the people started to have immoral relations with the daughters of Moʹab.

4473.label: Numbers 25:2
4473.text: And the women came calling the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people began to eat and to bow down to their gods.

4474.label: Numbers 25:3
4474.text: So Israel attached itself to the Baʹal of Peʹor; and the anger of Jehovah began to blaze against Israel.

4475.label: Numbers 25:4
4475.text: Hence Jehovah said to Moses: “Take all the head ones of the people and expose them to Jehovah toward the sun, that the burning anger of Jehovah may turn back from Israel.”

4476.label: Numbers 25:5
4476.text: Then Moses said to the judges of Israel: “Each one of YOU kill his men who have an attachment with the Baʹal of Peʹor.”

4477.label: Numbers 25:6
4477.text: But, look! a man of the sons of Israel came, and he was bringing near to his brothers a Midʹi·an·ite woman before Moses’ eyes and before the eyes of all the assembly of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

4478.label: Numbers 25:7
4478.text: When Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest caught sight of it, he at once got up from the midst of the assembly and took a lance in his hand.

4479.label: Numbers 25:8
4479.text: Then he went after the man of Israel into the vaulted tent and pierced both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her genital parts. At that the scourge was halted from upon the sons of Israel.

4480.label: Numbers 25:9
4480.text: And those who died from the scourge amounted to twenty-four thousand.

4481.label: Numbers 25:10
4481.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4482.label: Numbers 25:11
4482.text: “Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest has turned back my wrath from upon the sons of Israel by his tolerating no rivalry at all toward me in the midst of them, so that I have not exterminated the sons of Israel in my insistence on exclusive devotion.

4483.label: Numbers 25:12
4483.text: For that reason say, ‘Here I am giving him my covenant of peace.

4484.label: Numbers 25:13
4484.text: And it must serve as the covenant of a priesthood to time indefinite for him and his offspring after him, due to the fact that he tolerated no rivalry toward his God and proceeded to make atonement for the sons of Israel.’”

4485.label: Numbers 25:14
4485.text: Incidentally the name of the fatally struck Israelite man who was fatally struck with the Midʹi·an·i·tess was Zimʹri the son of Saʹlu, a chieftain of a paternal house of the Simʹe·on·ites.

4486.label: Numbers 25:15
4486.text: And the name of the Midʹi·an·ite woman fatally struck was Cozʹbi the daughter of Zur; he was a head one of the clans of a paternal house in Midʹi·an.

4487.label: Numbers 25:16
4487.text: Later Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4488.label: Numbers 25:17
4488.text: “Let there be a harassing of the Midʹi·an·ites, and YOU men must strike them,

4489.label: Numbers 25:18
4489.text: because they are harassing YOU with their deeds of cunning that they committed against YOU cunningly in the affair of Peʹor and in the affair of Cozʹbi the daughter of a chieftain of Midʹi·an, their sister who was fatally struck in the day of the scourge over the affair of Peʹor.”

4490.label: Numbers 26:1
4490.text: And it came about after the scourge, that Jehovah went on to say this to Moses and El·e·aʹzar the son of Aaron the priest:

4491.label: Numbers 26:2
4491.text: “TAKE the sum of the whole assembly of the sons of Israel from twenty years of age and upward, according to the house of their fathers, all those going out to the army in Israel.”

4492.label: Numbers 26:3
4492.text: And Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest proceeded to speak with them in the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho, saying:

4493.label: Numbers 26:4
4493.text: “[Take the sum of them] from the age of twenty years and upward, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.” Now the sons of Israel who went out of the land of Egypt were:

4494.label: Numbers 26:5
4494.text: Reuʹben, Israel’s firstborn; Reuʹben’s sons: Of Haʹnoch the family of the Haʹnoch·ites; of Palʹlu the family of the Palʹlu·ites;

4495.label: Numbers 26:6
4495.text: of Hezʹron the family of the Hezʹron·ites; of Carʹmi the family of the Carʹmites.

4496.label: Numbers 26:7
4496.text: These were the families of the Reuʹben·ites, and their registered ones amounted to forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.

4497.label: Numbers 26:8
4497.text: And the son of Palʹlu was E·liʹab.

4498.label: Numbers 26:9
4498.text: And the sons of E·liʹab: Nemʹu·el and Daʹthan and A·biʹram. This Daʹthan and A·biʹram were summoned ones of the assembly, who engaged in a struggle against Moses and Aaron in the assembly of Koʹrah, when they engaged in a struggle against Jehovah.

4499.label: Numbers 26:10
4499.text: Then the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up. As for Koʹrah, [he died] at the death of the assembly when the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men. And they came to be a symbol.

4500.label: Numbers 26:11
4500.text: However, the sons of Koʹrah did not die.

4501.label: Numbers 26:12
4501.text: The sons of Simʹe·on by their families: Of Nemʹu·el the family of the Nemʹu·el·ites; of Jaʹmin the family of the Jaʹmin·ites; of Jaʹchin the family of the Jaʹchin·ites;

4502.label: Numbers 26:13
4502.text: of Zeʹrah the family of the Zeʹrah·ites; of Shaʹul the family of the Sha·uʹlites.

4503.label: Numbers 26:14
4503.text: These were the families of the Simʹe·on·ites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.

4504.label: Numbers 26:15
4504.text: The sons of Gad by their families: Of Zeʹphon the family of the Zeʹphon·ites; of Hagʹgi the family of the Hagʹgites; of Shuʹni the family of the Shuʹnites;

4505.label: Numbers 26:16
4505.text: of Ozʹni the family of the Ozʹnites; of Eʹri the family of the Eʹrites;

4506.label: Numbers 26:17
