4506.text: of Arʹod the family of the Arʹod·ites; of A·reʹli the family of the A·reʹlites.

4507.label: Numbers 26:18
4507.text: These were the families of the sons of Gad, of their registered ones: forty thousand five hundred.

4508.label: Numbers 26:19
4508.text: The sons of Judah were Er and Oʹnan. However, Er and Oʹnan died in the land of Caʹnaan.

4509.label: Numbers 26:20
4509.text: And the sons of Judah came to be, by their families: Of Sheʹlah the family of the She·laʹnites; of Peʹrez the family of the Perʹe·zites; of Zeʹrah the family of the Zeʹrah·ites.

4510.label: Numbers 26:21
4510.text: And the sons of Peʹrez came to be: Of Hezʹron the family of the Hezʹron·ites; of Haʹmul the family of the Ha·muʹlites.

4511.label: Numbers 26:22
4511.text: These were the families of Judah, of their registered ones: seventy-six thousand five hundred.

4512.label: Numbers 26:23
4512.text: The sons of Isʹsa·char by their families were: Of Toʹla the family of the Toʹla·ites; of Puʹvah the family of the Puʹnites;

4513.label: Numbers 26:24
4513.text: of Jaʹshub the family of the Jashʹu·bites; of Shimʹron the family of the Shimʹron·ites.

4514.label: Numbers 26:25
4514.text: These were the families of Isʹsa·char, of their registered ones: sixty-four thousand three hundred.

4515.label: Numbers 26:26
4515.text: The sons of Zebʹu·lun by their families were: Of Seʹred the family of the Serʹe·dites; of Eʹlon the family of the Eʹlon·ites; of Jahʹle·el the family of the Jahʹle·el·ites.

4516.label: Numbers 26:27
4516.text: These were the families of the Ze·buʹlu·nites, of their registered ones: sixty thousand five hundred.

4517.label: Numbers 26:28
4517.text: The sons of Joseph by their families were Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im.

4518.label: Numbers 26:29
4518.text: The sons of Ma·nasʹseh were: Of Maʹchir the family of the Maʹchir·ites. And Maʹchir became father to Gilʹe·ad. Of Gilʹe·ad the family of the Gilʹe·ad·ites.

4519.label: Numbers 26:30
4519.text: These were the sons of Gilʹe·ad: Of Ieʹzer the family of the Ieʹzer·ites; of Heʹlek the family of the Heʹlek·ites;

4520.label: Numbers 26:31
4520.text: of Asʹri·el the family of the Asʹri·el·ites; of Sheʹchem the family of the Sheʹchem·ites;

4521.label: Numbers 26:32
4521.text: of She·miʹda the family of the She·miʹda·ites; of Heʹpher the family of the Heʹpher·ites.

4522.label: Numbers 26:33
4522.text: Now Ze·loʹphe·had the son of Heʹpher proved to have no sons, but daughters, and the names of the daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had were Mahʹlah and Noah, Hogʹlah, Milʹcah and Tirʹzah.

4523.label: Numbers 26:34
4523.text: These were the families of Ma·nasʹseh, and their registered ones were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

4524.label: Numbers 26:35
4524.text: These were the sons of Eʹphra·im by their families: Of Shuʹthe·lah the family of the Shuʹthel·aʹhites; of Beʹcher the family of the Beʹcher·ites; of Taʹhan the family of the Taʹhan·ites.

4525.label: Numbers 26:36
4525.text: And these were the sons of Shuʹthe·lah: Of Eʹran the family of the Eʹran·ites.

4526.label: Numbers 26:37
4526.text: These were the families of the sons of Eʹphra·im, of their registered ones: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These were the sons of Joseph by their families.

4527.label: Numbers 26:38
4527.text: The sons of Benjamin by their families were: Of Beʹla the family of the Beʹla·ites; of Ashʹbel the family of the Ashʹbel·ites; of A·hiʹram the family of the A·hiʹram·ites;

4528.label: Numbers 26:39
4528.text: of She·phuʹpham the family of the Shuʹpham·ites; of Huʹpham the family of the Huʹpham·ites.

4529.label: Numbers 26:40
4529.text: The sons of Beʹla came to be Ard and Naʹa·man: [Of Ard] the family of the Ardʹites; of Naʹa·man the family of the Naʹa·mites.

4530.label: Numbers 26:41
4530.text: These were the sons of Benjamin by their families, and their registered ones were forty-five thousand six hundred.

4531.label: Numbers 26:42
4531.text: These were the sons of Dan by their families: Of Shuʹham the family of the Shuʹham·ites. These were the families of Dan by their families.

4532.label: Numbers 26:43
4532.text: All the families of the Shuʹham·ites, of their registered ones, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

4533.label: Numbers 26:44
4533.text: The sons of Ashʹer by their families were: Of Imʹnah the family of the Imʹnites; of Ishʹvi the family of the Ishʹvites; of Be·riʹah the family of the Be·riʹites;

4534.label: Numbers 26:45
4534.text: of the sons of Be·riʹah: Of Heʹber the family of the Heʹber·ites; of Malʹchi·el the family of the Malʹchi·el·ites.

4535.label: Numbers 26:46
4535.text: And the name of Ashʹer’s daughter was Seʹrah.

4536.label: Numbers 26:47
4536.text: These were the families of the sons of Ashʹer, of their registered ones: fifty-three thousand four hundred.

4537.label: Numbers 26:48
4537.text: The sons of Naphʹta·li by their families were: Of Jahʹze·el the family of the Jahʹze·el·ites; of Guʹni the family of the Guʹnites;

4538.label: Numbers 26:49
4538.text: of Jeʹzer the family of the Jeʹzer·ites; of Shilʹlem the family of the Shilʹlem·ites.

4539.label: Numbers 26:50
4539.text: These were the families of Naphʹta·li by their families, and their registered ones were forty-five thousand four hundred.

4540.label: Numbers 26:51
4540.text: These were the registered ones of the sons of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.

4541.label: Numbers 26:52
4541.text: After that Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

4542.label: Numbers 26:53
4542.text: “To these the land should be apportioned for an inheritance by the number of the names.

4543.label: Numbers 26:54
4543.text: According to the great number you should increase one’s inheritance, and according to the fewness you should reduce one’s inheritance. Each one’s inheritance should be given in proportion to his registered ones.

4544.label: Numbers 26:55
4544.text: Only by the lot should the land be apportioned. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they should get an inheritance.

4545.label: Numbers 26:56
4545.text: By the determination of the lot one’s inheritance should be apportioned between the many and the few.”

4546.label: Numbers 26:57
4546.text: Now these were the registered ones of the Levites by their families: Of Gerʹshon the family of the Gerʹshon·ites; of Koʹhath the family of the Koʹhath·ites; of Me·rarʹi the family of the Me·rarʹites.

4547.label: Numbers 26:58
4547.text: These were the families of the Levites: the family of the Libʹnites, the family of the Heʹbron·ites, the family of the Mahʹlites, the family of the Muʹshites, the family of the Koʹrah·ites. And Koʹhath became father to Amʹram.

4548.label: Numbers 26:59
4548.text: And the name of Amʹram’s wife was Jochʹe·bed, Leʹvi’s daughter, whom his wife bore to Leʹvi in Egypt. In time she bore to Amʹram Aaron and Moses and Mirʹi·am their sister.

4549.label: Numbers 26:60
4549.text: Then there were born to Aaron Naʹdab and A·biʹhu, El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar.

4550.label: Numbers 26:61
4550.text: But Naʹdab and A·biʹhu died for their presenting illegitimate fire before Jehovah.

4551.label: Numbers 26:62
4551.text: And their registered ones amounted to twenty-three thousand, all males from a month old and upward. For they did not get registered in among the sons of Israel, because no inheritance was to be given to them in among the sons of Israel.

4552.label: Numbers 26:63
4552.text: These were the ones registered by Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest when they registered the sons of Israel in the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho.

4553.label: Numbers 26:64
4553.text: But among these there did not prove to be a man of those registered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they registered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Siʹnai.

4554.label: Numbers 26:65
4554.text: For Jehovah had said concerning them: “They will die without fail in the wilderness.” So there was not left of them a man except Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

4555.label: Numbers 27:1
4555.text: Then the daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had the son of Heʹpher the son of Gilʹe·ad the son of Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh, of the families of Ma·nasʹseh the son of Joseph, came near. And these were the names of his daughters: Mahʹlah, Noah and Hogʹlah and Milʹcah and Tirʹzah.

4556.label: Numbers 27:2
4556.text: And they proceeded to stand before Moses and before El·e·aʹzar the priest and before the chieftains and all the assembly at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying:

4557.label: Numbers 27:3
4557.text: “Our father has died in the wilderness, and yet he did not prove to be in among the assembly, that is, those who ranged themselves against Jehovah in the assembly of Koʹrah, but for his own sin he has died; and he did not get to have any sons.

4558.label: Numbers 27:4
4558.text: Why should the name of our father be taken away from the midst of his family because he had no son? O give us a possession in the midst of our father’s brothers.”

4559.label: Numbers 27:5
4559.text: At that Moses presented their case before Jehovah.

4560.label: Numbers 27:6
4560.text: Jehovah then said this to Moses:

4561.label: Numbers 27:7
4561.text: “The daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had are speaking right. By all means you should give them the possession of an inheritance in the midst of their father’s brothers, and you must cause their father’s inheritance to pass to them.

4562.label: Numbers 27:8
4562.text: And to the sons of Israel you should speak, saying, ‘In case any man should die without his having a son, YOU must then cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

4563.label: Numbers 27:9
4563.text: And if he has no daughter, YOU must then give his inheritance to his brothers.

4564.label: Numbers 27:10
4564.text: And if he has no brothers, YOU must then give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

4565.label: Numbers 27:11
4565.text: And if his father has no brothers, YOU must then give his inheritance to his blood relation who is closest to him of his family, and he must take possession of it. And it must serve as a statute by judicial decision for the sons of Israel, just as Jehovah has commanded Moses.’”

4566.label: Numbers 27:12
4566.text: Subsequently Jehovah said to Moses: “Go up into this mountain of Abʹa·rim and see the land that I shall certainly give the sons of Israel.

4567.label: Numbers 27:13
4567.text: When you have seen it, then you must be gathered to your people, yes, you, just as Aaron your brother was gathered,

4568.label: Numbers 27:14
4568.text: inasmuch as YOU men rebelled against my order in the wilderness of Zin at the quarreling of the assembly, in relation to sanctifying me by the waters before their eyes. These are the waters of Merʹi·bah at Kaʹdesh in the wilderness of Zin.”

4569.label: Numbers 27:15
4569.text: Then Moses spoke to Jehovah, saying:

4570.label: Numbers 27:16
4570.text: “Let Jehovah the God of the spirits of all sorts of flesh appoint over the assembly a man

4571.label: Numbers 27:17
4571.text: who will go out before them and who will come in before them and who will bring them out and who will bring them in, that Jehovah’s assembly may not become like sheep that have no shepherd.”

4572.label: Numbers 27:18
4572.text: So Jehovah said to Moses: “Take for yourself Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom there is spirit, and you must lay your hand upon him;

4573.label: Numbers 27:19
4573.text: and you must stand him before El·e·aʹzar the priest and before all the assembly, and you must commission him before their eyes.

4574.label: Numbers 27:20
4574.text: And you must put some of your dignity upon him, in order that all the assembly of the sons of Israel may listen to him.

4575.label: Numbers 27:21
4575.text: And it is before El·e·aʹzar the priest that he will stand, and he must inquire in his behalf by the judgment of the Uʹrim before Jehovah. At his order they will go out and at his order they will come in, he and all the sons of Israel with him and all the assembly.”

4576.label: Numbers 27:22
4576.text: And Moses proceeded to do just as Jehovah had commanded him. Accordingly he took Joshua and stood him before El·e·aʹzar the priest and before all the assembly

4577.label: Numbers 27:23
4577.text: and laid his hands upon him and commissioned him, just as Jehovah had spoken by means of Moses.

4578.label: Numbers 28:1
4578.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

4579.label: Numbers 28:2
4579.text: “Command the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘YOU should take care to present to me my offering, my bread, for my offerings made by fire as a restful odor to me, at their appointed times.’

4580.label: Numbers 28:3
4580.text: “And you must say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire that YOU will present to Jehovah: two sound year-old male lambs a day as a burnt offering constantly.

4581.label: Numbers 28:4
4581.text: The one male lamb you will render up in the morning, and the other male lamb you will render up between the two evenings,

4582.label: Numbers 28:5
4582.text: together with the tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour as a grain offering moistened with the fourth of a hin of beaten oil;

4583.label: Numbers 28:6
4583.text: the constant burnt offering, which was rendered up at Mount Siʹnai as a restful odor, an offering made by fire to Jehovah,

4584.label: Numbers 28:7
4584.text: along with its drink offering, the fourth of a hin to each male lamb. Pour out in the holy place the drink offering of intoxicating liquor to Jehovah.

4585.label: Numbers 28:8
4585.text: And you will render up the other male lamb between the two evenings. With the same grain offering as of the morning and with its same drink offering you will render it up as an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah.

4586.label: Numbers 28:9
4586.text: “‘However, on the sabbath day there will be two sound year-old male lambs and two tenth measures of fine flour as a grain offering moistened with oil, together with its drink offering,

4587.label: Numbers 28:10
4587.text: as a sabbath burnt offering on its sabbath, along with the constant burnt offering and its drink offering.

4588.label: Numbers 28:11
4588.text: “‘And at the commencements of YOUR months YOU people will present as a burnt offering to Jehovah two young bulls and one ram, seven sound male lambs each a year old,

4589.label: Numbers 28:12
4589.text: and three tenth measures of fine flour as a grain offering moistened with oil for each bull and two tenth measures of fine flour as a grain offering moistened with oil for the one ram,

4590.label: Numbers 28:13
4590.text: and a tenth measure of fine flour respectively as a grain offering moistened with oil for each male lamb, as a burnt offering, a restful odor, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

4591.label: Numbers 28:14
4591.text: And as their drink offerings there should go half a hin of wine for a bull and a third of a hin for the ram and a fourth of a hin for a male lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering in its month for the months of the year.

4592.label: Numbers 28:15
4592.text: Also, one kid of the goats should be rendered up as a sin offering to Jehovah in addition to the constant burnt offering together with its drink offering.

4593.label: Numbers 28:16
4593.text: “‘And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, will be Jehovah’s passover.

4594.label: Numbers 28:17
4594.text: And on the fifteenth day of this month will be a festival. Seven days unfermented cakes will be eaten.

4595.label: Numbers 28:18
4595.text: On the first day there will be a holy convention. No sort of laborious work must YOU do.

4596.label: Numbers 28:19
4596.text: And YOU must present as an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Jehovah, two young bulls and one ram and seven male lambs each a year old. They should prove to be sound ones for YOU.

4597.label: Numbers 28:20
4597.text: And as their grain offerings of fine flour moistened with oil YOU will render up three tenth measures for a bull and two tenth measures for the ram.

4598.label: Numbers 28:21
4598.text: You will render up a tenth measure respectively for each male lamb of the seven male lambs;

4599.label: Numbers 28:22
4599.text: and one goat of sin offering to make atonement for YOU.

4600.label: Numbers 28:23
4600.text: Aside from the morning burnt offering, which is for the constant burnt offering, YOU will render these up.

4601.label: Numbers 28:24
4601.text: The same as these YOU will render up daily for the seven days as bread, an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah. Along with the constant burnt offering it should be rendered, and its drink offering.

4602.label: Numbers 28:25
4602.text: And on the seventh day YOU should hold a holy convention. No sort of laborious work must YOU do.

4603.label: Numbers 28:26
4603.text: “‘And on the day of the first ripe fruits, when YOU present a new grain offering to Jehovah, in YOUR feast of weeks YOU should hold a holy convention. No sort of laborious work must YOU do.

4604.label: Numbers 28:27
4604.text: And YOU must present as a burnt offering for a restful odor to Jehovah two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs each a year old;

4605.label: Numbers 28:28
4605.text: and as their grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil three tenth measures for each bull, two tenth measures for the one ram,

4606.label: Numbers 28:29
4606.text: a tenth measure respectively for each male lamb of the seven male lambs;

4607.label: Numbers 28:30
4607.text: one kid of the goats to make atonement for YOU.

4608.label: Numbers 28:31
4608.text: Aside from the constant burnt offering and its grain offering YOU will render them up. They should prove to be sound ones for YOU, together with their drink offerings.

4609.label: Numbers 29:1
4609.text: “‘And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, YOU should hold a holy convention. No sort of laborious work must YOU do. It should prove to be a day of the trumpet blast for YOU.

4610.label: Numbers 29:2
4610.text: And YOU must render up as a burnt offering for a restful odor to Jehovah one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4611.label: Numbers 29:3
4611.text: and their grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil, three tenth measures for the bull, two tenth measures for the ram,

4612.label: Numbers 29:4
4612.text: and one tenth measure for each male lamb of the seven male lambs;

4613.label: Numbers 29:5
4613.text: and one male kid of the goats as a sin offering to make atonement for YOU;

4614.label: Numbers 29:6
4614.text: aside from the monthly burnt offering and its grain offering and the constant burnt offering and its grain offering, together with their drink offerings, according to the regular procedure for them, as a restful odor, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

4615.label: Numbers 29:7
4615.text: “‘And on the tenth of this seventh month YOU should hold a holy convention, and YOU must afflict YOUR souls. No sort of work must YOU do.

4616.label: Numbers 29:8
4616.text: And YOU must present as a burnt offering to Jehovah, as a restful odor, one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs each a year old. They should prove to be sound ones for YOU.

4617.label: Numbers 29:9
4617.text: And as their grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil three tenth measures for the bull, two tenth measures for the one ram,

4618.label: Numbers 29:10
4618.text: a tenth measure respectively for each male lamb of the seven male lambs;

4619.label: Numbers 29:11
4619.text: one kid of the goats as a sin offering, aside from the sin offering of atonement and the constant burnt offering and its grain offering, together with their drink offerings.

4620.label: Numbers 29:12
4620.text: “‘And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month YOU should hold a holy convention. No sort of laborious work must YOU do, and YOU must celebrate a festival to Jehovah seven days.

4621.label: Numbers 29:13
4621.text: And YOU must present as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah, thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old. They should prove to be sound ones.

4622.label: Numbers 29:14
4622.text: And as their grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil three tenth measures for each bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth measures for each ram of the two rams,

4623.label: Numbers 29:15
4623.text: and a tenth measure for each male lamb of the fourteen male lambs;

4624.label: Numbers 29:16
4624.text: and one kid of the goats as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering, its grain offering and its drink offering.

4625.label: Numbers 29:17
4625.text: “‘And on the second day twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4626.label: Numbers 29:18
4626.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4627.label: Numbers 29:19
4627.text: and one kid of the goats as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering and its grain offering, together with their drink offerings.

4628.label: Numbers 29:20
4628.text: “‘And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4629.label: Numbers 29:21
4629.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4630.label: Numbers 29:22
4630.text: and one goat as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.

4631.label: Numbers 29:23
4631.text: “‘And on the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4632.label: Numbers 29:24
4632.text: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4633.label: Numbers 29:25
4633.text: and one kid of the goats as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering, its grain offering and its drink offering.

4634.label: Numbers 29:26
4634.text: “‘And on the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4635.label: Numbers 29:27
4635.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4636.label: Numbers 29:28
4636.text: and one goat as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.

4637.label: Numbers 29:29
4637.text: “‘And on the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4638.label: Numbers 29:30
4638.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4639.label: Numbers 29:31
4639.text: and one goat as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering, its grain offering and its drink offerings.

4640.label: Numbers 29:32
4640.text: “‘And on the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4641.label: Numbers 29:33
4641.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure for them;

4642.label: Numbers 29:34
4642.text: and one goat as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering, its grain offering and its drink offering.

4643.label: Numbers 29:35
4643.text: “‘And on the eighth day YOU should hold a solemn assembly. No sort of laborious work must YOU do.

4644.label: Numbers 29:36
4644.text: And YOU must present as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah, one bull, one ram, seven male lambs each a year old, sound ones;

4645.label: Numbers 29:37
4645.text: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, the ram and the male lambs by their number according to the regular procedure;

4646.label: Numbers 29:38
4646.text: and one goat as a sin offering, aside from the constant burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.

4647.label: Numbers 29:39
4647.text: “‘These YOU will render up to Jehovah at YOUR seasonal festivals, besides YOUR vow offerings and YOUR voluntary offerings as YOUR burnt offerings and YOUR grain offerings and YOUR drink offerings and YOUR communion sacrifices.’”

4648.label: Numbers 29:40
4648.text: And Moses proceeded to talk to the sons of Israel according to everything that Jehovah had commanded Moses.

4649.label: Numbers 30:1
4649.text: Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying: “This is the word that Jehovah has commanded:

4650.label: Numbers 30:2
4650.text: In case a man makes a vow to Jehovah or swears an oath to bind a vow of abstinence upon his soul, he must not violate his word. According to all that has gone out of his mouth he should do.

4651.label: Numbers 30:3
4651.text: “And in case a woman makes a vow to Jehovah or she does bind herself with a vow of abstinence in the house of her father in her youth,

4652.label: Numbers 30:4
4652.text: and her father actually hears her vow or her abstinence vow that she has bound upon her soul and her father does keep silent toward her, all her vows must also stand, and every abstinence vow that she has bound upon her soul will stand.

4653.label: Numbers 30:5
4653.text: But if her father has forbidden her on the day of his hearing all her vows or her abstinence vows that she has bound upon her soul, it will not stand, but Jehovah will forgive her, because her father forbade her.

4654.label: Numbers 30:6
4654.text: “However, if she at all happens to belong to a husband, and her vow is upon her or the thoughtless promise of her lips that she has bound upon her soul,

4655.label: Numbers 30:7
4655.text: and her husband actually hears it and keeps silent toward her on the day of his hearing it, her vows must also stand or her abstinence vows that she has bound upon her soul will stand.

4656.label: Numbers 30:8
4656.text: But if her husband on the day of hearing it forbids her, he has also annulled her vow that was upon her or the thoughtless promise of her lips that she bound upon her soul, and Jehovah will forgive her.

4657.label: Numbers 30:9
4657.text: “In the case of the vow of a widow or a divorced woman, everything that she has bound upon her soul will stand against her.

4658.label: Numbers 30:10
4658.text: “However, if it is in the house of her husband that she has vowed or has bound an abstinence vow upon her soul by an oath,

4659.label: Numbers 30:11
4659.text: and her husband has heard it and has kept silent toward her, he has not forbidden her; and all her vows must stand or any abstinence vow that she has bound upon her soul will stand.

4660.label: Numbers 30:12
4660.text: But if her husband has totally annulled them on the day of his hearing any expression of her lips as her vows or as an abstinence vow of her soul, they will not stand. Her husband has annulled them, and Jehovah will forgive her.

4661.label: Numbers 30:13
4661.text: Any vow or any oath of an abstinence vow to afflict the soul, her husband should establish it or her husband should annul it.

4662.label: Numbers 30:14
4662.text: But if her husband absolutely keeps silent toward her from day to day, he has also established all her vows or all her abstinence vows that are upon her. He has established them because he kept silent toward her on the day of his hearing them.

4663.label: Numbers 30:15
4663.text: And if he totally annuls them after his hearing them, he also actually bears her error.

4664.label: Numbers 30:16
4664.text: “These are the regulations that Jehovah commanded Moses as between a husband and his wife, as between a father and his daughter in her youth in the house of her father.”

4665.label: Numbers 31:1
4665.text: Jehovah then spoke to Moses, saying:

4666.label: Numbers 31:2
4666.text: “Take vengeance for the sons of Israel upon the Midʹi·an·ites. Afterward you will be gathered to your people.”

4667.label: Numbers 31:3
4667.text: So Moses spoke to the people, saying: “Equip men from among YOU for the army, that they may serve against Midʹi·an to execute Jehovah’s vengeance upon Midʹi·an.

4668.label: Numbers 31:4
4668.text: A thousand of each tribe of all the tribes of Israel YOU will send into the army.”

4669.label: Numbers 31:5
4669.text: Accordingly from the thousands of Israel a thousand were assigned of a tribe, twelve thousand equipped for the army.

4670.label: Numbers 31:6
4670.text: Then Moses sent them out, a thousand of each tribe, to the army, them and Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar the priest to the army, and the holy utensils and the trumpets for blowing calls were in his hand.

4671.label: Numbers 31:7
4671.text: And they went waging war against Midʹi·an, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses, and they proceeded to kill every male.

4672.label: Numbers 31:8
4672.text: And they killed the kings of Midʹi·an along with the others slain, namely, Eʹvi and Reʹkem and Zur and Hur and Reʹba, the five kings of Midʹi·an; and they killed Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor with the sword.

4673.label: Numbers 31:9
4673.text: But the sons of Israel carried off the women of Midʹi·an and their little ones captive; and all their domestic animals and all their livestock and all their means of maintenance they plundered.

4674.label: Numbers 31:10
4674.text: And all their cities in which they had settled and all their walled camps they burned with fire.

4675.label: Numbers 31:11
4675.text: And they went taking all the spoil and all the booty in the way of humans and domestic animals.

4676.label: Numbers 31:12
4676.text: And they came bringing to Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest and to the assembly of the sons of Israel the captives and the booty and the spoil, to the camp, to the desert plains of Moʹab, which are by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho.

4677.label: Numbers 31:13
4677.text: Then Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest and all the chieftains of the assembly went out to meet them outside the camp.

4678.label: Numbers 31:14
4678.text: And Moses grew indignant at the appointed men of the combat forces, the chiefs of the thousands and the chiefs of the hundreds who were coming in from the military expedition.

4679.label: Numbers 31:15
4679.text: So Moses said to them: “Have YOU preserved alive every female?

4680.label: Numbers 31:16
4680.text: Look! They are the ones who, by Baʹlaam’s word, served to induce the sons of Israel to commit unfaithfulness toward Jehovah over the affair of Peʹor, so that the scourge came upon the assembly of Jehovah.

4681.label: Numbers 31:17
4681.text: And now kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has had intercourse with man by lying with a male.

4682.label: Numbers 31:18
4682.text: And preserve alive for yourselves all the little ones among the women who have not known the act of lying with a male.

4683.label: Numbers 31:19
4683.text: As for YOU yourselves, camp outside the camp seven days. Everyone who has killed a soul and everyone who has touched someone slain, YOU should purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, YOU and YOUR captives.

4684.label: Numbers 31:20
4684.text: And every garment and every article of skin and everything made of goat’s hair and every article of wood YOU should purify for yourselves from sin.”

4685.label: Numbers 31:21
4685.text: El·e·aʹzar the priest then said to the men of the army who had gone into the battle: “This is the statute of the law that Jehovah commanded Moses,

4686.label: Numbers 31:22
4686.text: ‘Only the gold and the silver, the copper, the iron, the tin and the lead,

4687.label: Numbers 31:23
4687.text: everything that is processed with fire, YOU should pass through the fire, and it must be clean. Only it should be purified by the water for cleansing. And everything that is not processed with fire YOU should pass through the water.

4688.label: Numbers 31:24
4688.text: And YOU must wash YOUR garments on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward YOU may come into the camp.’”

4689.label: Numbers 31:25
4689.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say this to Moses:

4690.label: Numbers 31:26
4690.text: “Take the sum of the booty, the captives both of humankind and of domestic animals, you and El·e·aʹzar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the assembly.

4691.label: Numbers 31:27
4691.text: And you must divide the booty in two between those taking part in the battle who went out on the expedition and all the rest of the assembly.

4692.label: Numbers 31:28
4692.text: And as a tax for Jehovah you must take away from the men of war who went out on the expedition one soul out of five hundred, of humankind and of the herd and of the asses and of the flock.

4693.label: Numbers 31:29
4693.text: From their half YOU should take it and you must give it to El·e·aʹzar the priest as Jehovah’s contribution.

4694.label: Numbers 31:30
4694.text: And from the half of the sons of Israel you should take one out of fifty, of humankind, of the herd, of the asses and of the flock, of every sort of domestic animal, and you must give them to the Levites, the keepers of the obligation of Jehovah’s tabernacle.”

4695.label: Numbers 31:31
4695.text: And Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest went doing just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

4696.label: Numbers 31:32
4696.text: And the booty, the rest of the plunder that the people of the expedition had taken as plunder, amounted to six hundred and seventy-five thousand of the flock,

4697.label: Numbers 31:33
4697.text: and seventy-two thousand of the herd,

4699.label: Numbers 31:35
4699.text: As for human souls from the women who had not known the act of lying with a male, all the souls were thirty-two thousand.

4700.label: Numbers 31:36
4700.text: And the half that was the share of those who went out on the expedition amounted in number to three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred of the flock.

4701.label: Numbers 31:37
4701.text: And the tax for Jehovah from the flock amounted to six hundred and seventy-five.

4702.label: Numbers 31:38
4702.text: And of the herd there were thirty-six thousand, and the tax on them for Jehovah was seventy-two.

4703.label: Numbers 31:39
4703.text: And the asses were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tax on them for Jehovah was sixty-one.

4704.label: Numbers 31:40
4704.text: And the human souls were sixteen thousand, and the tax on them for Jehovah was thirty-two souls.

4705.label: Numbers 31:41
4705.text: Then Moses gave the tax as Jehovah’s contribution to El·e·aʹzar the priest, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

4706.label: Numbers 31:42
4706.text: And from the half belonging to the sons of Israel, which Moses divided from that belonging to the men who waged war:

4707.label: Numbers 31:43
4707.text: Now the half of the assembly from the flock amounted to three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred,

4708.label: Numbers 31:44
4708.text: and of the herd, thirty-six thousand,

4709.label: Numbers 31:45
4709.text: and the asses, thirty thousand five hundred,

4711.label: Numbers 31:47
4711.text: Then Moses took from the half belonging to the sons of Israel the one to be taken out of fifty, of humankind and of domestic animals, and gave them to the Levites, the keepers of the obligation of Jehovah’s tabernacle, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

4712.label: Numbers 31:48
4712.text: And the appointed men who were of the thousands of the army, the chiefs of the thousands and the chiefs of the hundreds, proceeded to approach Moses,

4713.label: Numbers 31:49
4713.text: and to say to Moses: “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are in our charge and not one has been reported missing from us.

4714.label: Numbers 31:50
4714.text: So let us present each one what he has found as Jehovah’s offering, articles of gold, ankle chainlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and female ornaments, in order to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.”

4715.label: Numbers 31:51
4715.text: Accordingly Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest accepted the gold from them, all the jewelry.

4716.label: Numbers 31:52
4716.text: And all the gold of the contribution that they contributed to Jehovah amounted to sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from the chiefs of the thousands and the chiefs of the hundreds.

4717.label: Numbers 31:53
4717.text: The men of the army had taken plunder each for himself.

4718.label: Numbers 31:54
4718.text: So Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest accepted the gold from the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the sons of Israel before Jehovah.

4719.label: Numbers 32:1
4719.text: Now the sons of Reuʹben and the sons of Gad had come to have numerous livestock, very many, in fact. And they began to see the land of Jaʹzer and the land of Gilʹe·ad, and, look! the place was a place for livestock.

4720.label: Numbers 32:2
4720.text: Hence the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuʹben came and said this to Moses and El·e·aʹzar the priest and to the chieftains of the assembly:

4721.label: Numbers 32:3
4721.text: “Atʹa·roth and Diʹbon and Jaʹzer and Nimʹrah and Heshʹbon and E·le·aʹleh and Seʹbam and Neʹbo and Beʹon,

4722.label: Numbers 32:4
4722.text: the land that Jehovah defeated before the assembly of Israel, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.”

4723.label: Numbers 32:5
4723.text: And they went on to say: “If we have found favor in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”

4724.label: Numbers 32:6
4724.text: Then Moses said to the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuʹben: “Are YOUR brothers to go to war while YOU yourselves keep dwelling here?

4725.label: Numbers 32:7
4725.text: And why should YOU dishearten the sons of Israel from crossing into the land that Jehovah will certainly give them?

4726.label: Numbers 32:8
4726.text: That is the way YOUR fathers did when I sent them from Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a to see the land.

4727.label: Numbers 32:9
4727.text: When they went up to the torrent valley of Eshʹcol and saw the land, then they disheartened the sons of Israel, so as not to go into the land that Jehovah was certain to give them.

4728.label: Numbers 32:10
4728.text: Consequently Jehovah’s anger blazed on that day so that he swore, saying,

4729.label: Numbers 32:11
4729.text: ‘The men who came up out of Egypt from twenty years old upward will not see the soil of which I have sworn to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, because they have not followed me wholly,

4730.label: Numbers 32:12
4730.text: except Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh the Kenʹiz·zite and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Jehovah wholly.’

4731.label: Numbers 32:13
4731.text: So Jehovah’s anger blazed against Israel and he made them wander about in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that was doing evil in the eyes of Jehovah came to their end.

4732.label: Numbers 32:14
4732.text: And here YOU have risen in the place of YOUR fathers as the brood of sinful men in order to add further to the burning anger of Jehovah against Israel.

4733.label: Numbers 32:15
4733.text: In case YOU should turn back from following him, he also would certainly once again let them stay longer in the wilderness, and YOU would have acted ruinously toward all this people.”

4734.label: Numbers 32:16
4734.text: Later they approached him and said: “Let us build here stone flock pens for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

4735.label: Numbers 32:17
4735.text: But we ourselves shall go equipped in battle formation before the sons of Israel until whenever we have brought them to their place, while our little ones must dwell in the cities with fortifications away from the face of the inhabitants of the land.

4736.label: Numbers 32:18
4736.text: We shall not return to our houses until the sons of Israel have provided themselves with landed property, each with his own inheritance.

4737.label: Numbers 32:19
4737.text: For we shall not get an inheritance with them from the side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us from the side of the Jordan toward the sunrising.”

4738.label: Numbers 32:20
4738.text: At this Moses said to them: “If YOU will do this thing, if YOU will equip yourselves before Jehovah for the war,

4739.label: Numbers 32:21
4739.text: and every equipped one of YOURS will actually pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he drives away his enemies from before him,

4740.label: Numbers 32:22
4740.text: and the land is actually subdued before Jehovah, and afterward YOU return, YOU also will indeed prove yourselves free from guilt against Jehovah and against Israel; and this land must become YOURS as a possession before Jehovah.

4741.label: Numbers 32:23
4741.text: But if YOU will not do this way, YOU will also certainly sin against Jehovah. In that case know that YOUR sin will catch up with YOU.

4742.label: Numbers 32:24
4742.text: Build for yourselves cities for YOUR little ones and stone pens for YOUR flocks, and what has gone forth from YOUR mouth YOU should do.”

4743.label: Numbers 32:25
4743.text: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuʹben said this to Moses: “Your servants will do just as my lord is commanding.

4744.label: Numbers 32:26
4744.text: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock and all our domestic animals will stay there in the cities of Gilʹe·ad,

4745.label: Numbers 32:27
4745.text: but your servants will pass over, everyone equipped for the army, before Jehovah for the war, just as my lord is speaking.”

4746.label: Numbers 32:28
4746.text: Accordingly Moses gave a command respecting them to El·e·aʹzar the priest and to Joshua the son of Nun and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

4747.label: Numbers 32:29
4747.text: So Moses said to them: “If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuʹben pass with YOU over the Jordan, everyone equipped for the war, before Jehovah, and the land is actually subdued before YOU, YOU must then give them the land of Gilʹe·ad as a possession.

4748.label: Numbers 32:30
4748.text: But if they do not pass over equipped with YOU, they must then be settled in YOUR midst in the land of Caʹnaan.”

4749.label: Numbers 32:31
4749.text: To this the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuʹben answered, saying: “What Jehovah has spoken to your servants is the way we shall do.

4750.label: Numbers 32:32
4750.text: We ourselves will pass over equipped before Jehovah to the land of Caʹnaan, and the possession of our inheritance will be with us on this side of the Jordan.”

4751.label: Numbers 32:33
4751.text: At this Moses gave to them, that is, to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuʹben and to half the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites and the kingdom of Og the king of Baʹshan, the land belonging to its cities in the territories, and the cities of the land round about.

4752.label: Numbers 32:34
4752.text: And the sons of Gad proceeded to build Diʹbon and Atʹa·roth and A·roʹer,

4753.label: Numbers 32:35
4753.text: and Atʹroth-shoʹphan and Jaʹzer and Jogʹbe·hah,

4754.label: Numbers 32:36
4754.text: and Beth-nimʹrah and Beth-haʹran, cities with fortifications, and stone flock pens.

4755.label: Numbers 32:37
4755.text: And the sons of Reuʹben built Heshʹbon and E·le·aʹleh and Kir·i·a·thaʹim,

4756.label: Numbers 32:38
4756.text: and Neʹbo and Baʹal-meʹon —their names being changed—and Sibʹmah; and they began to call by their own names the names of the cities that they built.

4757.label: Numbers 32:39
4757.text: And the sons of Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh proceeded to march to Gilʹe·ad and to capture it and to drive away the Amʹor·ites who were in it.

4758.label: Numbers 32:40
4758.text: So Moses gave Gilʹe·ad to Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh, and he took up dwelling in it.

4759.label: Numbers 32:41
4759.text: And Jaʹir the son of Ma·nasʹseh marched and went capturing their tent villages, and he began to call them Havʹvoth-jaʹir.

4760.label: Numbers 32:42
4760.text: And Noʹbah marched and went capturing Keʹnath and its dependent towns; and he began to call it Noʹbah by his own name.

4761.label: Numbers 33:1
4761.text: These were the stages of the sons of Israel who went out of the land of Egypt in their armies by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

4762.label: Numbers 33:2
4762.text: And Moses kept recording the departure places by their stages at the order of Jehovah; and these were their stages from one departure place to another:

4763.label: Numbers 33:3
4763.text: And they proceeded to pull away from Ramʹe·ses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. Directly the day after the passover the sons of Israel went out with uplifted hand before the eyes of all the Egyptians.

4764.label: Numbers 33:4
4764.text: All the while the Egyptians were burying those whom Jehovah had struck among them, that is, all the firstborn; and upon their gods Jehovah had executed judgments.

4765.label: Numbers 33:5
4765.text: So the sons of Israel pulled away from Ramʹe·ses and went camping in Sucʹcoth.

4766.label: Numbers 33:6
4766.text: Then they pulled away from Sucʹcoth and went camping in Eʹtham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.

4767.label: Numbers 33:7
4767.text: Next they pulled away from Eʹtham and turned back toward Pi·ha·hiʹroth, which is in view of Baʹal-zeʹphon; and they went camping before Migʹdol.

4768.label: Numbers 33:8
4768.text: After that they pulled away from Pi·ha·hiʹroth and went passing through the midst of the sea to the wilderness and kept marching a three-day journey in the wilderness of Eʹtham and took up camping at Maʹrah.

4769.label: Numbers 33:9
4769.text: Then they pulled away from Maʹrah and came to Eʹlim. Now in Eʹlim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. So they camped there.

4770.label: Numbers 33:10
4770.text: Next they pulled away from Eʹlim and went camping by the Red Sea.

4771.label: Numbers 33:11
4771.text: After that they pulled away from the Red Sea and took up camping in the wilderness of Sin.

4772.label: Numbers 33:12
4772.text: Then they pulled away from the wilderness of Sin and went camping at Dophʹkah.

4773.label: Numbers 33:13
4773.text: Later they pulled away from Dophʹkah and went camping at Aʹlush.

4774.label: Numbers 33:14
4774.text: They next pulled away from Aʹlush and went camping in Rephʹi·dim. And there proved to be no water there for the people to drink.

4775.label: Numbers 33:15
4775.text: After that they pulled away from Rephʹi·dim and went camping in the wilderness of Siʹnai.

4776.label: Numbers 33:16
4776.text: Subsequently they pulled away from the wilderness of Siʹnai and went camping at Kibʹroth-hat·taʹa·vah.

4777.label: Numbers 33:17
4777.text: Then they pulled away from Kibʹroth-hat·taʹa·vah and went camping in Ha·zeʹroth.

4778.label: Numbers 33:18
4778.text: After that they pulled away from Ha·zeʹroth and went camping in Rithʹmah.

4779.label: Numbers 33:19
4779.text: Next they pulled away from Rithʹmah and took up camping in Rimʹmon-peʹrez.

4780.label: Numbers 33:20
4780.text: Then they pulled away from Rimʹmon-peʹrez and went camping in Libʹnah.

4781.label: Numbers 33:21
4781.text: Later they pulled away from Libʹnah and went camping in Risʹsah.

4782.label: Numbers 33:22
4782.text: Next they pulled away from Risʹsah and went camping in Ke·he·laʹthah.

4783.label: Numbers 33:23
4783.text: Then they pulled away from Ke·he·laʹthah and went camping in Mount Sheʹpher.

4784.label: Numbers 33:24
4784.text: After that they pulled away from Mount Sheʹpher and went camping in Har·aʹdah.

4785.label: Numbers 33:25
4785.text: Then they pulled away from Har·aʹdah and went camping in Mak·heʹloth.

4786.label: Numbers 33:26
4786.text: Next they pulled away from Mak·heʹloth and went camping in Taʹhath.

4787.label: Numbers 33:27
4787.text: After that they pulled away from Taʹhath and went camping in Teʹrah.

4788.label: Numbers 33:28
4788.text: Then they pulled away from Teʹrah and went camping in Mithʹkah.

4789.label: Numbers 33:29
4789.text: Later they pulled away from Mithʹkah and went camping in Hash·moʹnah.

4790.label: Numbers 33:30
4790.text: Next they pulled away from Hash·moʹnah and went camping in Mo·seʹroth.

4791.label: Numbers 33:31
4791.text: Then they pulled away from Mo·seʹroth and went camping in Benʹe-jaʹa·kan.

4792.label: Numbers 33:32
4792.text: After that they pulled away from Benʹe-jaʹa·kan and went camping in Hor-hag·gidʹgad.

4793.label: Numbers 33:33
4793.text: Next they pulled away from Hor-hag·gidʹgad and went camping in Jotʹba·thah.

4794.label: Numbers 33:34
4794.text: Later they pulled away from Jotʹba·thah and went camping in A·broʹnah.

4795.label: Numbers 33:35
4795.text: Then they pulled away from A·broʹnah and went camping in Eʹzi·on-geʹber.

4796.label: Numbers 33:36
4796.text: After that they pulled away from Eʹzi·on-geʹber and went camping in the wilderness of Zin, that is to say, Kaʹdesh.

4797.label: Numbers 33:37
4797.text: Later they pulled away from Kaʹdesh and went camping in Mount Hor, on the frontier of the land of Eʹdom.

4798.label: Numbers 33:38
4798.text: And Aaron the priest proceeded to go up into Mount Hor at the order of Jehovah and to die there in the fortieth year of the going out of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month.

4799.label: Numbers 33:39
4799.text: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old at his death on Mount Hor.

4800.label: Numbers 33:40
4800.text: Now the Caʹnaan·ite, the king of Aʹrad, as he was dwelling in the Negʹeb, in the land of Caʹnaan, got to hear about the coming of the sons of Israel.

4801.label: Numbers 33:41
4801.text: In time they pulled away from Mount Hor and went camping in Zal·moʹnah.

4802.label: Numbers 33:42
4802.text: After that they pulled away from Zal·moʹnah and went camping in Puʹnon.

4803.label: Numbers 33:43
4803.text: Next they pulled away from Puʹnon and went camping in Oʹboth.

4804.label: Numbers 33:44
4804.text: Then they pulled away from Oʹboth and went camping in Iʹye-abʹa·rim on the border of Moʹab.

4805.label: Numbers 33:45
4805.text: Later they pulled away from Iʹyim and went camping in Diʹbon-gad.

4806.label: Numbers 33:46
4806.text: After that they pulled away from Diʹbon-gad and went camping in Alʹmon-dib·la·thaʹim.

4807.label: Numbers 33:47
4807.text: Then they pulled away from Alʹmon-dib·la·thaʹim and went camping in the mountains of Abʹa·rim before Neʹbo.

4808.label: Numbers 33:48
4808.text: Finally they pulled away from the mountains of Abʹa·rim and took up camping on the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho.

4809.label: Numbers 33:49
4809.text: And they continued camping by the Jordan from Beth-jeshʹi·moth to Aʹbel-shitʹtim on the desert plains of Moʹab.

4810.label: Numbers 33:50
4810.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses on the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho, saying:

4811.label: Numbers 33:51
4811.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘YOU are crossing the Jordan into the land of Caʹnaan.

4812.label: Numbers 33:52
4812.text: And YOU must drive away all the inhabitants of the land from before YOU and destroy all their stone figures, and all their images of molten metal YOU should destroy, and all their sacred high places YOU should annihilate.

4813.label: Numbers 33:53
4813.text: And YOU must take possession of the land and dwell in it, because to YOU I shall certainly give the land to take possession of it.

4814.label: Numbers 33:54
4814.text: And YOU must apportion the land to yourselves as a possession by lot according to YOUR families. To the populous one YOU should increase his inheritance, and to the sparse one YOU should reduce his inheritance. To where the lot will come out for him, there it will become his. By the tribes of YOUR fathers YOU should provide yourselves with landed property.

4815.label: Numbers 33:55
4815.text: “‘If, though, YOU will not drive the inhabitants of the land away from before YOU, then those whom YOU leave of them will certainly become as pricks in YOUR eyes and as thorns in YOUR sides, and they will indeed harass YOU on the land in which YOU will be dwelling.

4816.label: Numbers 33:56
4816.text: And it must occur that just as I had figured doing to them I shall do to YOU.’”

4817.label: Numbers 34:1
4817.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

4818.label: Numbers 34:2
4818.text: “Command the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘YOU are going into the land of Caʹnaan. This is the land that will fall to YOU by inheritance, the land of Caʹnaan according to its boundaries.

4819.label: Numbers 34:3
4819.text: “‘And YOUR south side must prove to be from the wilderness of Zin alongside Eʹdom, and YOUR south boundary must prove to be from the extremity of the Salt Sea on the east.

4820.label: Numbers 34:4
4820.text: And YOUR boundary must change direction from the south of the ascent of A·krabʹbim and cross over to Zin, and its termination must prove to be on the south of Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a; and it must go out to Haʹzar-adʹdar and pass over to Azʹmon.

4821.label: Numbers 34:5
4821.text: And the boundary must change direction at Azʹmon to the torrent valley of Egypt, and its termination must prove to be at the Sea.

4822.label: Numbers 34:6
4822.text: “‘As for a west boundary, it must prove to be for YOU the Great Sea and the shoreland. This will become YOUR west boundary.

4823.label: Numbers 34:7
4823.text: “‘Now this will become YOUR north boundary: From the Great Sea YOU will mark out to Mount Hor as a boundary for yourselves.

4824.label: Numbers 34:8
4824.text: From Mount Hor YOU will mark out the boundary to the entering in of Haʹmath, and the termination of the boundary must prove to be at Zeʹdad.

4825.label: Numbers 34:9
4825.text: And the boundary must go out to Ziphʹron, and its termination must prove to be Haʹzar-eʹnan. This will become YOUR north boundary.

4826.label: Numbers 34:10
4826.text: “‘Then YOU must mark for yourselves as YOUR boundary on the east from Haʹzar-eʹnan to Sheʹpham.

4827.label: Numbers 34:11
4827.text: And the boundary must go down from Sheʹpham to Ribʹlah on the east of Aʹin, and the border must go down and strike upon the eastern slope of the sea of Chinʹne·reth.

4828.label: Numbers 34:12
4828.text: And the border must go down to the Jordan, and its termination must prove to be the Salt Sea. This will become YOUR land according to its boundaries all around.’”

4829.label: Numbers 34:13
4829.text: So Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying: “This is the land that YOU will apportion to yourselves as a possession by lot, just as Jehovah has commanded to give to the nine and a half tribes.

4830.label: Numbers 34:14
4830.text: For the tribe of the sons of the Reuʹben·ites by the house of their fathers and the tribe of the sons of the Gadʹites by the house of their fathers have already taken, and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh have already taken their inheritance.

4831.label: Numbers 34:15
4831.text: The two and a half tribes have already taken their inheritance from the region of the Jordan by Jerʹi·cho eastward toward the sunrising.”

4832.label: Numbers 34:16
4832.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

4833.label: Numbers 34:17
4833.text: “These are the names of the men who will divide the land to YOU people for a possession, El·e·aʹzar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

4834.label: Numbers 34:18
4834.text: And YOU will take one chieftain out of each tribe to divide the land for a possession.

4835.label: Numbers 34:19
4835.text: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh;

4836.label: Numbers 34:20
4836.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on, She·muʹel the son of Am·miʹhud;

4837.label: Numbers 34:21
4837.text: of the tribe of Benjamin, E·liʹdad the son of Chisʹlon;

4838.label: Numbers 34:22
4838.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Dan a chieftain, Bukʹki the son of Jogʹli;

4839.label: Numbers 34:23
4839.text: of the sons of Joseph, of the tribe of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh a chieftain, Hanʹni·el the son of Eʹphod;

4840.label: Numbers 34:24
4840.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Eʹphra·im a chieftain, Kem·uʹel the son of Shiphʹtan;

4841.label: Numbers 34:25
4841.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Zebʹu·lun a chieftain, E·li·zaʹphan the son of Parʹnach;

4842.label: Numbers 34:26
4842.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Isʹsa·char a chieftain, Palʹti·el the son of Azʹzan;

4843.label: Numbers 34:27
4843.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Ashʹer a chieftain, A·hiʹhud the son of She·loʹmi;

4844.label: Numbers 34:28
4844.text: and of the tribe of the sons of Naphʹta·li a chieftain, Ped·ahʹel the son of Am·miʹhud.”

4845.label: Numbers 34:29
4845.text: These are the ones whom Jehovah commanded to make the sons of Israel landholders in the land of Caʹnaan.

4846.label: Numbers 35:1
4846.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses on the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho, saying:

4847.label: Numbers 35:2
4847.text: “Give the sons of Israel the command that they must give the Levites cities to inhabit out of the inheritance of their possession, and they should give the Levites the pasture ground of the cities all around them.

4848.label: Numbers 35:3
4848.text: And the cities must serve for them to inhabit, while their pasture grounds will serve for their domestic animals and their goods and for all their wild beasts.

4849.label: Numbers 35:4
4849.text: And the pasture grounds of the cities, which YOU will give the Levites, will be from the wall of the city and out for a thousand cubits all around.

4850.label: Numbers 35:5
4850.text: And YOU must measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits and on the south side two thousand cubits and on the west side two thousand cubits and on the north side two thousand cubits, with the city in the middle. This will serve them as pasture grounds of the cities.

4851.label: Numbers 35:6
4851.text: “These are the cities that YOU will give to the Levites: six cities of refuge, which YOU will give for the manslayer to flee there, and besides them YOU will give forty-two other cities.

4852.label: Numbers 35:7
4852.text: All the cities that YOU will give to the Levites will be forty-eight cities, they together with their pasture grounds.

4853.label: Numbers 35:8
4853.text: The cities that YOU will give will be from the possession of the sons of Israel. From the many YOU will take many, and from the few YOU will take few. Each one, in proportion to his inheritance that he will take as a possession, will give some of his cities to the Levites.”

4854.label: Numbers 35:9
4854.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

4855.label: Numbers 35:10
4855.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘YOU are crossing the Jordan to the land of Caʹnaan.

4856.label: Numbers 35:11
4856.text: And YOU must choose cities convenient for yourselves. As cities of refuge they will serve for YOU, and the manslayer must flee there who fatally strikes a soul unintentionally.

4857.label: Numbers 35:12
4857.text: And the cities must serve YOU as a refuge from the blood avenger, that the manslayer may not die until he stands before the assembly for judgment.

4858.label: Numbers 35:13
4858.text: And the cities that YOU will give, the six cities of refuge, will be at YOUR service.

4859.label: Numbers 35:14
4859.text: Three cities YOU will give on this side of the Jordan, and three cities YOU will give in the land of Caʹnaan. As cities of refuge they will serve.

4860.label: Numbers 35:15
4860.text: For the sons of Israel and for the alien resident and for the settler in the midst of them these six cities will serve as a refuge, for anyone to flee there that fatally strikes a soul unintentionally.

4861.label: Numbers 35:16
4861.text: “‘Now if it was with an instrument of iron that he has struck him so that he dies, he is a murderer. Without fail the murderer should be put to death.

4862.label: Numbers 35:17
4862.text: And if it was with a small stone by which he could die that he has struck him so that he dies, he is a murderer. Without fail the murderer should be put to death.

4863.label: Numbers 35:18
4863.text: And if it was with a small instrument of wood by which he could die that he has struck him so that he dies, he is a murderer. Without fail the murderer should be put to death.

4864.label: Numbers 35:19
4864.text: “‘The avenger of blood is the one who will put the murderer to death. When he chances upon him he himself will put him to death.

4865.label: Numbers 35:20
4865.text: And if in hatred he was pushing him or he has thrown at him while lying in wait that he might die,

4866.label: Numbers 35:21
4866.text: or in enmity he has struck him with his hand that he might die, without fail the striker should be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood will put the murderer to death when he chances upon him.

4867.label: Numbers 35:22
4867.text: “‘But if it was unexpectedly without enmity that he has pushed him or has thrown any article toward him without lying in wait,

4868.label: Numbers 35:23
4868.text: or any stone by which he could die without seeing him or he should cause it to fall upon him, so that he died, while he was not at enmity with him and was not seeking his injury,

4869.label: Numbers 35:24
4869.text: the assembly must then judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these judgments.

4870.label: Numbers 35:25
4870.text: And the assembly must deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the assembly must return him to his city of refuge to which he had fled, and he must dwell in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

4871.label: Numbers 35:26
4871.text: “‘But if the manslayer without fail goes out of the boundary of his city of refuge to which he may flee,

4872.label: Numbers 35:27
4872.text: and the avenger of blood does find him outside the boundary of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood does slay the manslayer, he has no bloodguilt.

4873.label: Numbers 35:28
4873.text: For he ought to dwell in his city of refuge until the high priest’s death, and after the high priest’s death the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.

4874.label: Numbers 35:29
4874.text: And these must serve as a statute of judgment for YOU throughout YOUR generations in all YOUR dwelling places.

4875.label: Numbers 35:30
4875.text: “‘Every fatal striker of a soul should be slain as a murderer at the mouth of witnesses, and one witness may not testify against a soul for him to die.

4876.label: Numbers 35:31
4876.text: And YOU must take no ransom for the soul of a murderer who is deserving to die, for without fail he should be put to death.

4877.label: Numbers 35:32
4877.text: And YOU must not take a ransom for one who has fled to his city of refuge, to resume dwelling in the land before the death of the high priest.

4878.label: Numbers 35:33
4878.text: “‘And YOU must not pollute the land in which YOU are; because it is blood that pollutes the land, and for the land there may be no atonement respecting the blood that has been spilled upon it except by the blood of the one spilling it.

4879.label: Numbers 35:34
4879.text: And you must not defile the land in which YOU are dwelling, in the midst of which I am residing; for I Jehovah am residing in the midst of the sons of Israel.’”

4880.label: Numbers 36:1
4880.text: And the heads of the fathers of the family of the sons of Gilʹe·ad the son of Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh of the families of the sons of Joseph proceeded to come near and speak before Moses and the chieftains, the heads of the fathers of the sons of Israel,

4881.label: Numbers 36:2
4881.text: and say: “Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land in inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel; and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Ze·loʹphe·had our brother to his daughters.

4882.label: Numbers 36:3
4882.text: If any of the sons of the other tribes of the sons of Israel happened to get them as wives, the women’s inheritance must also be withdrawn from the inheritance of our fathers and must be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they may come to belong, so that it would be withdrawn from the lot of our inheritance.

4883.label: Numbers 36:4
4883.text: Now if the Jubilee takes place for the sons of Israel, the women’s inheritance must also be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they may come to belong; so that their inheritance would be withdrawn from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

4884.label: Numbers 36:5
4884.text: Then Moses commanded the sons of Israel at the order of Jehovah, saying: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph is speaking right.

4885.label: Numbers 36:6
4885.text: This is the word that Jehovah has commanded for the daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had, saying, ‘To whom it is good in their eyes they may become wives. Only it is to the family of the tribe of their fathers that they should become wives.

4886.label: Numbers 36:7
4886.text: And no inheritance of the sons of Israel should circulate from tribe to tribe, because the sons of Israel should cleave each one to the inheritance of the tribe of his forefathers.

4887.label: Numbers 36:8
4887.text: And every daughter getting possession of an inheritance out of the tribes of the sons of Israel, to one of the family of the tribe of her father she should become a wife, in order that the sons of Israel may get possession each one of the inheritance of his forefathers.

4888.label: Numbers 36:9
4888.text: And no inheritance should circulate from one tribe to another tribe, because the tribes of the sons of Israel should cleave each to its own inheritance.’”

4889.label: Numbers 36:10
4889.text: Just as Jehovah had commanded Moses, that is the way the daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had did.

4890.label: Numbers 36:11
4890.text: Accordingly Mahʹlah, Tirʹzah and Hogʹlah and Milʹcah and Noah, the daughters of Ze·loʹphe·had, became the wives of the sons of their father’s brothers.

4891.label: Numbers 36:12
4891.text: To some of the families of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh the son of Joseph they became wives, that their inheritance might continue together with the tribe of the family of their father.

4892.label: Numbers 36:13
4892.text: These are the commandments and the judicial decisions that Jehovah commanded by means of Moses to the sons of Israel on the desert plains of Moʹab by the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho.
